description:
Com experiência em gestão de negócios, desde 1955, a WLM atua no segmento automotivo e no agronegócio.

O principal foco dos negócios da WLM é a comercialização de produtos e serviços da marca Scania , como caminhões pesados e extrapesados, chassis para ônibus rodoviários e urbanos, venda de peças genuínas, na prestação de serviços de manutenção corretiva e preventiva e assistência técnica especializada.

No segmento de concessionárias Scania , a WLM está presente em mais 20 pontos do país, atendendo a 06 estados diferentes, sendo Equipo - RJ, Itaipu - MG, Itaipu Norte - PA, Quinta Roda - SP e Supermac - AM e RR.

No segmento do agronegócio , por meio de suas controladas Fartura (Sul do Pará) e Itapura (Norte do Mato Grosso, Sul de Minas e região de Campinas/SP) , a WLM atua nas atividades de cria, recria e engorda de bovinos e produção e comercialização de café, soja e milho. Com grande preocupação pela conservação do meio ambiente, as atividades produtivas são executadas visando as melhores práticas de preservação da fauna e flora nativas e cuidados com as águas e o solo.

Em 2025, a WLM anunciou a aquisição de 60% da CHP Brasil , empresa referência em geração distribuída e eficiência energética.

Com essa aquisição, a WLM amplia sua presença estratégica, diversifica seu portfólio e dá um passo significativo em direção ao futuro, reforçando seu compromisso com a sustentabilidade e a criação de novas oportunidades de negócio no setor de energia.

A localização estratégica das unidades permite uma atuação com abrangente cobertura geográfica, garantindo presteza, qualidade e agilidade no atendimento.

A sua holding está localizada no Rio de Janeiro e possui uma filial corporativa em Minas Gerais, na Cidade de Contagem.

Vem acelerar a sua carreira com o Grupo WLM!

Executar manutenções elétricas prediais, realizando montagem, substituição, limpeza, reparo e instalação de peças, componentes e equipamentos elétricos.

Além disso, realizar curativos, administração de medicamentos e outros procedimentos de enfermagem.

  6. Acompanhamento de Programas de Saúde Ocupacional: Participar ativamente de programas de saúde ocupacional, como o Programa de Controle Médico de Saúde Ocupacional (PCMSO) e o Programa de Prevenção de Riscos Ambientais (PPRA), realizando avaliações, coletas de dados e análise de resultados.

Job description

O Engenheiro Especialista será o responsável técnico pela verificação e aprovação dos projetos de detalhamento de toda a infraestrutura de drenagem (pluvial e industrial) e sistemas hidráulico-sanitários da unidade. O foco é garantir o gerenciamento eficiente e seguro de fluidos, o controle de efluentes e a proteção ambiental, em conformidade com as normas e requisitos do cliente.

Main responsibilities

Responsabilidades Chave:

  1. Verificação de Projetos de Drenagem: Revisar e validar projetos detalhados de sistemas de drenagem pluvial (captação, condutores e descarte) e drenagem industrial (águas oleosas, ácidas, etc.), incluindo caixas separadoras de óleo e água (CSOA), bacias de contenção e diques.
  2. Verificação de Instalações Hidráulico-Sanitárias: Revisar e aprovar projetos de detalhamento de redes de água potável, esgoto sanitário, estações de tratamento de efluentes (ETE) e caixas de gordura/passagem, garantindo a salubridade das edificações de apoio.
  3. Dimensionamento e Modelagem: Garantir a correta realização de estudos hidrológicos e hidráulicos, bem como o dimensionamento de tubulações, canais, caixas e dispositivos de controle de vazão.
  4. Conformidade Normativa: Assegurar que os projetos estejam em total conformidade com as Normas Técnicas Brasileiras (ABNT), regulamentações ambientais vigentes (órgãos federais, estaduais e municipais) e padrões internos do cliente.
  5. Interface com Processo e Meio Ambiente: Atuar em coordenação com as disciplinas de Processo e Meio Ambiente para garantir que o projeto de drenagem industrial atenda aos requisitos de tratamento e descarte de efluentes.
  6. Especificações e MTO: Revisar e aprovar especificações técnicas para tubulações, conexões, materiais (polietileno, concreto, PRFV, etc.) e demais componentes do sistema, além das listas de materiais MTO.
  7. Suporte à Construção: Prestar suporte técnico especializado para a correta implantação das redes subterrâneas e demais instalações em campo.

Requirements and skills

Requisitos Mandatórios do Cliente:

  • Formação: Graduação completa em Engenharia Civil.
  • Registro Profissional: Registro ativo e em dia no Conselho de Classe pertinente (CREA).
  • Experiência Mínima: Pelo menos 8 (oito) anos de experiência comprovada em projetos de detalhamento de:
  • Drenagem (pluvial e industrial/oleosa).
  • Instalações Hidráulico Sanitárias.
  • Setor de Atuação: Experiência comprovada em, no mínimo, 3 (três) projetos de detalhamento nas áreas citadas para unidades de refino, petroquímica, produção e tratamento de gás e energia.
  • Responsabilidade Principal: Ser o profissional responsável pela verificação (revisão e aprovação técnica) dos projetos de detalhamento de drenagem e instalações hidráulico sanitárias.

Conhecimentos e Habilidades Desejáveis:

  • Pós-graduação ou Especialização em Engenharia Sanitária e Ambiental, ou Recursos Hídricos.
  • Domínio em softwares de modelagem de redes de drenagem.
  • Experiência com projetos de bacias de contenção e diques de segurança, conforme normas aplicáveis ao armazenamento de produtos perigosos.
  • Conhecimento em sistemas de combate a incêndio (hidrantes e reservatórios), com interface com a disciplina de Mecânica/Tubulação.

A área de Marketing BP Portfólio é estratégica para conectar as prioridades do negócio às necessidades dos consumidores por meio de campanhas, análises e iniciativas que fortalecem os produtos e a marca. Com foco nos lançamentos do catálogo, a área atua avaliando oportunidades, orientando as decisões de marketing e articulando ações integradas que ampliam o impacto e a relevância de cada produto no mercado. Diversidade:

Criamos ambientes onde todas as pessoas são incluídas, acolhidas e valorizadas. Nos empenhamos em ser uma Globo cada vez mais diversa, em representatividade e pensamento, aprendendo uns com os outros e estimulando a criatividade e inovação.

Acreditamos na intencionalidade para gerar movimentos transformadores, que reconheçam que diferentes grupos sociais partem de diferentes realidades que precisam ser levadas em consideração e acolhidas pelas pessoas e pelo negócio.

Equipes representativas trazem inovação inclusiva, nos permitindo criar experiências emocionantes para diferentes tipos de pessoas.

Queremos ser cada vez mais o lugar onde todas as pessoas se encontram e, por isso, essa vaga é para você, pessoa com deficiência , que quer crescer e construir o futuro com a gente, nos bastidores de produtos e serviços que impactam a vida de milhões de brasileiros e brasileiras todos os dias.

Como será seu dia a dia:

  • Desenvolver briefings completos, estratégicos e estruturados, capazes de orientar equipes internas de criação, mídia, social e demais áreas de marketing. Isso inclui traduzir necessidades de negócio em objetivos de comunicação, definir públicos-alvo, proposta de valor, entregáveis esperados, prazos, indicadores de sucesso e alinhamento com a estratégia geral do produto;
  • Desenvolver os planos de marketing e comunicação dos produtos;
  • Acompanhar KPIs e métricas-chave das campanhas (awareness, performance, conversão, ROI), analisar dados e comportamentos do público, identificar aprendizados relevantes e propor otimizações contínuas. Transformar números em recomendações acionáveis, contribuindo para decisões estratégicas e aprimoramento das próximas iniciativas;
  • Pesquisar e analisar o mercado, comportamentos de consumidores, movimentações de mercado e tendências. Avaliar dados setoriais, benchmarking e insights externos para embasar estratégias, identificar lacunas e antecipar oportunidades que fortaleçam a atuação da marca e dos produtos;
  • Contribuir com a construção de estratégias de mídia multicanal — digital, social, offline e outros — garantindo o alinhamento com objetivos de negócio e público-alvo;
  • Atuar em parceria com áreas internas e parceiros externos para implementar ações de marketing que potencializem os objetivos estratégicos do negócio. Acompanhar entregas e cronogramas, facilitar alinhamentos e assegurar que todas as ações estejam conectadas à estratégia.

Do que você precisa:

  • Graduação completa em Marketing, Comunicação, Publicidade e Propaganda ou áreas correlatas;
  • Sólido conhecimento em estratégias e planejamento de marketing;
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de análise de dados e métricas de desempenho (Google Analytics, dashboards, métricas de mídia, KPIs de campanha);
  • Conhecimentos em mídia digital e canais de comunicação (mídia paga, social, CRM, conteúdo);
  • Experiência prévia (entre 2–4 anos) em funções de marketing, preferencialmente atuando com campanhas, produtos ou projetos integrados;
  • Vivência na condução e acompanhamento de campanhas do início ao fim — briefing, execução e análise de resultados;
  • Experiência trabalhando em parceria com áreas internas, stakeholders e fornecedores externos (agências, produtoras, veículos etc.);
  • Histórico de gerar insights a partir de dados e propor otimizações ou novas abordagens estratégicas;
  • Pensamento Analítico e Orientado a Dados: capacidade de interpretar informações, identificar padrões, tirar conclusões e transformar dados em recomendações práticas e acionáveis;
  • Comunicação Clara e Assertiva: habilidade para transmitir ideias de forma objetiva e estruturada, seja em apresentações, conversas com stakeholders ou construção de briefings;
  • Organização e Gestão de Prioridades: capacidade de lidar com múltiplas demandas simultâneas, estruturar entregas e manter o controle sobre prazos e alinhamentos;
  • Proatividade e Autonomia: postura ativa para antecipar necessidades, buscar informações, resolver problemas e propor melhorias sem depender de orientação constante.
  • Excelência na criação de apresentações em PowerPoint, com forte capacidade de estruturar narrativas claras e visualmente atraentes. Inclui domínio de design de slides, organização lógica do storytelling e capacidade de sintetizar informações complexas de forma simples e envolvente;

  • Vivência em ações de marketing integradas com times de produto, growth ou CRM, especialmente em ambientes digitais ou de tecnologia;

Attend relevant conferences, workshops, working groups, interagency coordination meetings, and other forums.

Participate in the preparation of project proposals and a diverse range of communication products, concept notes and other planning documents.

Supervise and provide training and technical guidance to project staff.

Undertake duty travel relating to project implementation, monitoring visits, project assessments, liaison with counterparts, etc.

Perform other work-related tasks, as required.

Bachelor’s degree in political or social sciences, International Relations, Development Studies, Migration Studies, Human Rights, Law or related fields from an accredited academic institution with two years of relevant professional experience; or,

Master’s degree in the above-mentioned fields.

Experience in social and economic integration projects in partnership with government, civil society, UN and private sector actors.

Experience implementing and monitoring social and economic integration projects in partnership with government, civil society, UN, or private sector actors.

Strong ability to establish and maintain strong working relations with relevant government counterparts, civil society, international organizations and private sector entities.

Field experience related to migration, refugees and stateless population.

Experience performing administrative tasks.

  • Minimum five years’ experience in marketing roles, preferable at lubricants sector at known Oil Industries

Note: This is a home‑based office role in Brazil

  • Collaborate with experienced colleagues with unique expertise.

  • Join an organization working to become one of the most diverse and inclusive in the world. We strongly encourage applicants of all genders, ages, ethnicities, cultures, abilities, sexual orientation, and life experiences to apply.

A SUA ROTINA INCLUI:

1. Estrutura de Cargos e Salários

Atuar como guardião da política de cargos e salários, apoiando revisões, melhorias e desdobramentos junto às áreas de negócio.

Conduzir análises de equilíbrio interno (faixas, sobreposições, compressão salarial, enquadramentos) e propor ajustes em estruturas, níveis e grades.

Apoiar e/ou liderar processos de descrição, avaliação e classificação de cargos, utilizando metodologias corporativas (pontos, fatores, famílias, trilhas de carreira etc.).

Atualizar e manter tabelas salariais, referências, amplitudes e ranges por unidade de negócio, nível e função, garantindo coerência com a estrutura organizacional.

2. Pesquisas de Mercado e Competitividade Externa

Coordenar a participação da Log-In em pesquisas salariais de mercado (empresas de consultoria, sindicatos e entidades setoriais), garantindo qualidade das informações enviadas.

Analisar resultados de pesquisas (ex.: P50, P25, P75) e elaborar estudos comparativos de competitividade por cargo, família, unidade de negócio e região.

Elaborar recomendações técnicas de posicionamento salarial, ajustes de faixa, política para novos cargos e estratégias para funções críticas e de difícil reposição.

3. Ciclos de Mérito, Ajustes Gerais e Recomposição

Planejar, modelar e simular cenários de mérito, promoções, ajustes de faixas e recomposição por Acordo Coletivo, considerando budget, diretrizes de Diretoria e impacto em folha.

Desenvolver ferramentas (planilhas, modelos, painéis) que suportem alocação de verba de mérito pelas lideranças, garantindo simplicidade e governança.

Apoiar Gente & Gestão e a Diretoria na definição de diretrizes anuais (critérios de elegibilidade, limites, prazos e mensagens-chave) para os ciclos de revisão salarial.

Acompanhar a execução dos processos no sistema (ERP, HCM etc.), tratando exceções, conferindo resultados e assegurando integridade de dados.

4. Programas de Remuneração Variável e Incentivos

Apoiar a modelagem, revisão e governança de programas de remuneração variável (bônus/PLR, incentivos de curto prazo, comissões, gratificações), alinhados à estratégia e resultados do negócio.

Desenvolver e analisar indicadores, metas e pesos dos programas de incentivo em parceria com Finanças, áreas de negócio e Gente & Gestão.

Elaborar simulações de cenários de pagamento, impacto financeiro e comparativos históricos, apoiando decisões da Diretoria e do Conselho, quando aplicável.

5. Análises, Estudos Especiais e Governança

Produzir dashboards, relatórios e análises de remuneração (pay mix, pay gap, estrutura por nível, dispersão, headcount e payroll) para Diretoria, Comitês e Conselhos, quando demandado.

Apoiar estudos de reorganização organizacional (fusões de áreas, criação/extinção de cargos, movimentações em massa), avaliando impactos em remuneração e propondo soluções técnicas.

Atuar como referência para consultas complexas de remuneração das áreas (pacotes de contratação, retenção, realocação, casos críticos e exceções), garantindo aderência às políticas e governança.

Apoiar iniciativas relacionadas à equidade interna, diversidade e inclusão do ponto de vista de remuneração (estudos de pay equity, recortes por gênero, raça, unidade etc.).

6. Processos, Sistemas e Melhoria Contínua

Propor e liderar melhorias em processos, políticas, ferramentas e sistemas de remuneração, buscando mais automação, segurança e padronização.

Atuar em conjunto com TI, Finanças e Gente & Gestão na evolução de sistemas de folha, HCM, analytics e workflow relacionados a cargos, salários e incentivos.

Contribuir para a documentação e atualização de normas, políticas, manuais e comunicados de remuneração, garantindo entendimento por parte de líderes e colaboradores.

Conhecer a política, objetivos e metas do Sistema de Gestão Integrada.

Cumprir os procedimentos aplicáveis à atividade desenvolvida e os programas de qualidade, meio ambiente, saúde e segurança implementados na Companhia.

Conhecer os aspectos e impactos significativos associados às práticas de remuneração e contribuir para a melhoria contínua dentro do seu escopo.

A Aegea Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.

A Concessionária A Águas do Rio, concessionária da Aegea, é responsável pelo abastecimento de água e esgotamento sanitário em 27 municípios do estado do Rio de Janeiro, incluindo 124 bairros da capital, atendendo 10 milhões de pessoas.

Descrição da vaga Durante o período de concessão, iniciado em 1º de novembro de 2021, a companhia realizou o maior investimento em saneamento básico no país, em torno de R$ 39 bilhões. Programa Respeito dá o Tom O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa. Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.

A Aegea tem o compromisso com a promoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças. Aqui, todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados no processo seletivo, independentemente de raça, gênero, orientação sexual, religião, naturalidade, nacionalidade, deficiência, idade ou outras características.

title: Mineral Strategy Analyst - Aramco Transition Minerals -  (Based in Saudi Arabia - expat relocat[...]
description:
This position requires full relocation to Saudi Arabia. It is a permanent, expat position.

Overview

We are seeking an experienced Transition Minerals Strategy Analyst to join Aramco Transition Minerals organization to lead our efforts in securing, managing, and optimizing the sustainable use of transition minerals critical to the global energy transition. These minerals, such as lithium, cobalt, nickel, and rare earth elements, are essential for renewable energy technologies, and other clean energy solutions. The ideal candidate will bring deep expertise in strategic planning, supply chain management, ESG (Environmental, Social, and Governance) principles, and policy advocacy. This role will also involve collaboration across industries, governments, and communities to address challenges and opportunities in the evolving transition minerals landscape.

About Aramco Transition Minerals (ATM)

Aramco Transition Minerals (ATM) is a new strategic initiative within Saudi Aramco’s Upstream division, created to advance the exploration, extraction, and processing of key energy transition minerals—including lithium—to support the global shift toward sustainable energy solutions and contribute to the Kingdom’s economic diversification goals.

Anchored in the ambitions of Saudi Arabia’s Vision 2030, ATM is positioned to help establish the Kingdom as a leading global hub for critical minerals. The organization focuses on high‑value resources such as lithium, silicon, copper, nickel, graphite, and rare earth elements—materials essential to technologies like electric vehicles, renewable energy storage systems, and solar power generation.

As a newly formed and rapidly growing entity, ATM represents a significant opportunity to shape an emerging sector, drive technological innovation, and support the development of a resilient, future‑focused minerals supply chain.

Key Responsibilities

As a successful candidate you will be required to perform the following:

  • Lead the development of a comprehensive, long-term strategy for sourcing and utilizing transition minerals. This strategy should align with our organizational goals in sustainability, innovation, and growth.
  • Monitor and interpret global trends, including technological advancements, regulatory changes, and market dynamics, to identify opportunities and risks for the organization.
  • Establish a roadmap for securing critical mineral resources while prioritizing long‑term sustainability and resilience.
  • Provide insights and recommendations on mineral financing strategies, investment opportunities, and risk management.
  • Collaborate with procurement and legal teams to establish long‑term agreements with suppliers who meet sustainability criteria.
  • Act as a liaison between the company and key external stakeholders, including government agencies, potential investors and industry groups
  • Represent the company at international conferences, working groups, and forums focused on transition minerals, ensuring our leadership and reputation in the industry.
  • Develop and review financial models, feasibility studies, and cost‑benefit analyses for mining and mineral projects.
  • Lead or support the evaluation, negotiation, and execution of projects, ensuring alignment with company goals and industry best practices
  • Develop mitigation strategies to address risks such as resource scarcity, geopolitical tensions, and supply disruptions.
  • Stay ahead of emerging technologies and trends that could redefine the transition minerals landscape.
  • Track and report on global mineral production, consumption patterns, and pricing trends to inform decision‑making.
  • Continuously monitor and analyze industry data, reports, and market trends to provide actionable insights to the leadership team.
  • Develop comprehensive reports and presentations for executive leadership, detailing progress, risks, and recommendations.

As a successful candidate you hold a:

  • A bachelor’s degree or higher in Finance, Economics, Mining Geology, Business Administration, or a related field is preferred
  • Minimum of 7 years of experience in energy transition minerals (lithium, cobalt, nickel, or rare earth elements) development with a focus in strategy.
  • The ability to work effectively in multi-disciplinary teams, to communicate effectively and clearly with specialists in other cross‑functional teams, and has excellent problem‑solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Expertise in critical minerals such as lithium, cobalt, nickel, and rare earth elements, including their applications, extraction methods, and market dynamics
  • Strong understanding of mineralogy and metallurgical principles for transition minerals.
  • Knowledge of circular economy principles and recycling of transition minerals.
  • The ability to develop the business case strategically.
  • The ability to relocate to Saudi Arabia on a full‑time basis.
  • Advanced English proficiency. CV's must be submitted in English.

Aramco energizes the world economy.

Aramco occupies a special position in the global energy industry. We are one of the world’s largest producers of hydrocarbon energy and chemicals, with among the lowest Upstream carbon intensities of any major producer.

With our significant investment in technology and infrastructure, we strive to maximize the value of the energy we produce for the world along with a commitment to enhance Aramco’s value to society.

Headquartered in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, and with offices around the world, we combine market discipline with a generations’ spanning view of the future, born of our nine decades experience as responsible stewards of the Kingdom’s vast hydrocarbon resources. This responsibility has driven us to deliver significant societal and economic benefits to not just the Kingdom, but also to a vast number of communities, economies, and countries that rely on the vital and reliable energy that we supply.

We are one of the most profitable companies in the world, as well as amongst the top five global companies by market capitalization.

title: Cloud Engineer (GCP)
description:
At Paymentology , we’re redefining what’s possible in the payments space. As the first truly global issuer-processor, we give banks and fintechs the technology and talent to launch and manage Mastercard and Visa cards at scale - across more than 60 countries.

Our advanced, multi-cloud platform delivers real-time data, unmatched scalability, and the flexibility of shared or dedicated processing instances. It's this global reach and innovation that sets us apart.

We’re looking for a Cloud Engineer (GCP) to design, build, and operate secure, scalable, and highly available cloud infrastructure powering our global payments platform. As a senior technical specialist, you will own cloud architecture decisions across Google Cloud Platform, contribute to multi-cloud implementations, and ensure our infrastructure meets strict performance, security, and regulatory requirements.

If you're an expert in GCP, Kubernetes, and Infrastructure-as-Code, and thrive in complex, high-availability environments, this is your opportunity to shape the future of cloud infrastructure in a truly global fintech environment.

What you get to do

  • Lead the design and implementation of scalable, secure cloud architectures on Google Cloud Platform.
  • Define, implement, and maintain Infrastructure-as-Code using Terraform to ensure repeatable and reliable deployments.
  • Architect, build, and support multi-cloud environments aligned with business and platform strategy.
  • Implement and maintain cloud security controls aligned with PCI DSS, ISO 27001, and other regulatory standards.
  • Maintain cloud migration initiatives from on-premises environments to GCP, ensuring minimal disruption and optimal performance.
  • Continuously optimize cloud environments for cost efficiency, scalability, observability, and resilience.

Optional

  • Design, deploy, and operate Kubernetes (GKE) clusters and Kafka platforms to support distributed, high-throughput systems.

Requirements

What it takes to succeed

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in cloud engineering or infrastructure engineering roles.
  • Deep expertise in Google Cloud Platform and cloud-native architecture principles.
  • Advanced knowledge of Terraform and modern DevOps tooling for Infrastructure-as-Code and CI/CD automation.
  • Strong understanding of distributed systems, scalability, performance tuning, and cloud security best practices.
  • Experience operating in regulated, high-availability, or payments environments.
  • Ability to operate autonomously as a trusted technical owner, solving complex, multi-system challenges and influencing cloud standards across teams.
  • Strong understanding of GCP global architecture including Regions, Zones, and Global VPC design.
  • Strong IAM expertise covering roles, service accounts, and least privilege implementation.
  • Ability to design scalable VPC architectures including hub-and-spoke and Shared VPC models.
  • Good networking fundamentals including subnets, routing, and GCP firewall rule configuration.
  • Good to have experience with APIGEE/API gateway.

Nice to have

  • Hands-on experience with Kubernetes (GKE) and Kafka in production environments.

What you can look forward to

At Paymentology , it’s not just about building great payment technology, it’s about building a company where people feel they belong and their work matters. You’ll be part of a diverse, global team that’s genuinely committed to making a positive impact through what we do. Whether you’re working across time zones or getting involved in initiatives that support local communities, you’ll find real purpose in your work - and the freedom to grow in a supportive, forward-thinking environment.

Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Job Description

The position

Reporting to the Head of Special Events, the Senior Special Events Manager will serve as a senior leader within the FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™ organization. This role is a pivotal member of the Local Organizing Structure, working in close collaboration with the FIFA Zurich Project Team, internal functional areas, Host Cities, Commercial Affiliates, Government Authorities, and other key stakeholders to deliver exceptional, world‑class event experiences that elevate the tournament’s global impact.

Role Purpose: The Senior Special Events Manager is responsible for the strategic planning, creative development, operational execution, and overall management of all official FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™ special events. The role ensures seamless, high‑quality delivery aligned with FIFA’s brand standards, commercial objectives, and global audience expectations.

Impact & Scope: The Senior Special Events Manager will play a critical role in shaping some of the most visible and globally broadcast moments of the FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™. From milestone launches to the Final Draw, this position directly contributes to the tournament’s international perception, commercial success, and legacy in Brazil.

The successful candidate will demonstrate strong strategic vision, exceptional organizational and leadership skills, creative excellence, and the ability to operate effectively in a complex, fast‑paced, and multicultural environment.

Key responsibilities

1, Strategic Event Planning & Delivery

Lead the end-to-end planning and execution of major tournament‑related events, including but not limited to:

  • Oficial Dinner
  • Final Draw
  • Brand Launch
  • Mascot Launch
  • Team Workshop
  • Volunteers Kick‑Off Event
  • Guest activities, when required
  • Coordination of Legends Matches
  • Participation in pre‑match ceremonies
  • Additional milestone and stakeholder events throughout the tournament lifecycle
  • Develop comprehensive event strategies, timelines, and delivery frameworks to ensure consistent quality, innovation, and alignment with FIFA’s global positioning.

2. Creative Direction & Experience Design

  • Drive the creative vision and thematic development of each event in alignment with FIFA brand guidelines.
  • Oversee event concepts, production design, show flow, staging, entertainment, and guest experience.
  • Ensure all events reflect the prestige, inclusivity, and global significance of the FIFA Women’s World Cup™.

3. Operational & Logistical Oversight

  • Manage all operational aspects including venue selection, supplier procurement, production management, accreditation, guest services, protocol, and security coordination.
  • Ensure integrated planning across broadcast, marketing, communications, hospitality, and competition functions.
  • Implement detailed contingency and risk management plans to guarantee flawless delivery.

4. Budget & Financial Management

  • Develop, monitor, and control event budgets across multiple initiatives.
  • Optimize resource allocation while maintaining premium standards.
  • Manage vendor contracts and ensure cost efficiency, compliance, and financial transparency.

5. Stakeholder & Partner Coordination

  • Serve as the primary liaison for internal departments, Host Cities, commercial partners, sponsors, government authorities, and international delegations related to special events.
  • Coordinate with the FIFA Zurich Project Team to ensure alignment with global event standards and reporting structures.
  • Manage protocol requirements and high‑profile guest engagement including FIFA leadership, participating member associations, VIPs, and media.

6. Team Leadership & Management

  • Lead and mentor a multidisciplinary project team across different FIFA Functional Areas, fostering collaboration, accountability, and high performance.
  • Oversee external agencies and production partners, ensuring clear deliverables and performance standards.
  • Build a positive team culture aligned with FIFA values.

Your profile

Education

  • A Master’s degree (MBA) in Event Management, Sports Management, Business Administration, Marketing, Communications, Hospitality Management, or a related field.
  • Additional executive education in large-scale event production, leadership, or project management is advantageous.

Experience

  • Minimum of 8–10 years of progressive experience in large-scale international event management, preferably within global sporting events, major entertainment productions, or multinational organizations.
  • Proven experience leading high‑profile, broadcast‑level events such as draws, ceremonies, gala dinners, launches, or government‑level functions.
  • Demonstrated experience managing multi‑million‑dollar budgets and complex procurement processes.
  • Strong background in stakeholder management involving senior executives, sponsors, government authorities, and international delegations.
  • Experience working in matrix organizations and collaborating with global headquarters or international governing bodies is highly desirable.
  • Previous experience within FIFA tournaments or comparable mega‑events (e.g., Olympic Games, continental championships, global expos) is a strong advantage.

Skills & Competencie

Strategic & Operational Excellence

  • Strong ability to translate strategic objectives into comprehensive event delivery plans.
  • Exceptional project management skills with the ability to manage multiple large-scale initiatives simultaneously.
  • Advanced knowledge of event production, show calling, staging, audiovisual integration, and broadcast requirements.

Leadership & Team Management

  • Proven leadership capability with experience managing multidisciplinary teams and external agencies.
  • Ability to inspire, mentor, and drive high performance in fast‑paced environments.
  • Strong decision‑making skills under pressure.

Financial & Commercial Acumen

  • Solid budget planning, financial oversight, and cost‑control expertise.
  • Understanding of sponsorship integration and brand alignment within event environments.

Communication & Stakeholder Engagement

  • Excellent interpersonal and negotiation skills.
  • Ability to manage high‑level protocol and VIP relations with professionalism and discretion.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English; proficiency in Portuguese and/or Spanish is highly desirable.

Personal Attributes

  • Highly organized, detail‑oriented, and solutions‑driven.
  • Resilient and adaptable in dynamic, multicultural environments.
  • Creative mindset with strong attention to brand experience and innovation.
  • High integrity and alignment with FIFA’s values of inclusion, teamwork, and excellence.

Requiriments

  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)

About FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027

The FIFA Women’s World Cup™ is the greatest women’s sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women’s football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we’re looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

title: Financial Analyst
description:
We’re helping an international finance and M&A consultancy find a Financial Analyst to support transaction advisory, fundraising, and strategic finance projects for high-growth startups and scaleups.

You’ll build sophisticated financial models, prepare investor and board materials, and support valuation and deal execution across software and deeptech companies. This is a hands‑on, high‑accountability role where flawless work is non‑negotiable — your analyses will directly inform key decisions and client strategies.

This role is ideal for someone who is a wizard with numbers , detail‑obsessed yet commercially minded, and capable of seeing both the story and strategy behind the spreadsheets .

Part time to start, no. of hours/week can be negotiated during the initial interview, with possibility of transitioning to full time
Schedule: CET working hours
Location: Fully Remote
Engagement: Independent Contractor
Compensation: $2400-$3680 for full time

Key Responsibilities

  • Financial Modelling (Forecast & Scenario Analysis)
    Build fully linked 3-statement financial models with sensitivities and scenarios (base, downside, management).
    Create cash flow forecasts, liquidity bridges, and valuation-ready modules (DCF, comps, transaction comps).

  • Historical Restatement & Data Hygiene
    Reconcile and clean raw data (GL exports, bank data, SaaS metrics) into analysis‑ready formats.
    Maintain version control, audit trails, and traceability from trial balance to model.

  • Reporting Templates & Automation
    Design board and investor reporting templates, KPI dashboards, and variance analysis frameworks.
    Build SaaS metrics (ARR/MRR bridges, churn, LTV/CAC, NRR) and recurring revenue templates.

  • Transaction Support (Model-Led)
    Produce deal‑ready schedules for buy‑side and sell‑side engagements (QofE, NWC, closing adjustments).
    Translate model outputs into charts and visuals for investment memorandums and management presentations.

  • Quality Assurance & Standards
    Follow strict QA processes (FAST/SMART methodology).
    Double-check every formula, input, and output — your work must be flawless .
    Ensure transparency through consistent assumptions pages, error checks, and version logs.

Requirements

  • 3–6 years of experience in M&A, Transaction Services, or FP&A , ideally from a Tier 1 investment bank or M&A boutique .

    • Candidates with more years of experience will also be considered if they remain flexible and open to new approaches.

  • Strong experience working with software companies ; exposure to deeptech (e.g., chipmakers) is a plus.

  • Advanced Excel/Google Sheets proficiency (array formulas, Power Query, dynamic formulas, structured refs).

  • Excellent grasp of valuation and deal mechanics (NWC, closing adjustments, leakage, earn-outs).

  • Ability to turn messy data into clear historicals and models — quickly and accurately.

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills — able to explain the story behind the numbers.

  • Meticulous attention to detail and ability to self-check work before submission.

Nice‑to‑Haves

  • Experience preparing materials for investment memorandums (IMs).

  • Familiarity with CAPEX modelling and debt structuring.

  • Previous experience in software or SaaS transactions ; exposure to deeptech deals a bonus.

How Our Client Works

  • Theyown the numbers — every figure must be backed by logic, traceability, and quality assurance.

  • Theybalance precision with practicality — models should be easy to hand over and fast to update.

  • Theytranslate numbers into narratives — this role will eventually expand into creating investment memorandums where financial insights tell the story.

Recruitment Process

  1. Initial Interview

  2. Second Interview + possibly a test assignment

  3. Final Interview

4. Offer and onboarding

ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.

Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.

E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

Impulsionar a ciência e a educação para todos.

Promover o uso inovador de redes avançadas.

Nossa visão:

Ser reconhecida pela sociedade brasileira como a instituição que, fazendo o uso inovador das Tecnologias da Informação e Comunicação (TIC), provê a integração global da comunidade acadêmica, contribuindo para a melhoria da qualidade do ensino e da pesquisa e colaborando com o desenvolvimento tecnológico, social e econômico do país.

Com 124 anos de história, a Gerdau é a maior empresa brasileira produtora de aço e uma das principais fornecedoras de aços longos nas Américas e de aços especiais no mundo. No Brasil, também produz aços planos, além de minério de ferro para consumo próprio. Além disso, possui uma divisão de novos negócios, a Gerdau Next, com o objetivo de empreender em segmentos adjacentes ao aço. Com o propósito de empoderar pessoas que constroem o futuro, a companhia está presente em vários países e conta com mais de 30 mil colaboradores em todas as suas operações.

Maior recicladora da América Latina, a Gerdau tem na sucata uma importante matéria-prima: mais de 70% do aço que produz é feito a partir desse material. Todo ano, 11 milhões de toneladas de sucata são transformadas em diversos produtos de aço. A companhia também é a maior produtora de carvão vegetal do mundo, com mais de 250 mil hectares de base florestal no estado de Minas Gerais.

Como resultado de sua matriz produtiva sustentável, a Gerdau possui, atualmente, uma das menores médias de emissão de gases de efeito estufa (CO₂e), de 0,91 t de CO₂e por tonelada de aço, o que representa aproximadamente a metade da média global do setor, de 1,91 t de CO₂e por tonelada de aço (worldsteel). Para 2031, a meta da Gerdau é diminuir as emissões de carbono para 0,82 t de CO₂e por tonelada de aço. As ações da Gerdau estão listadas nas bolsas de valores de São Paulo(B3) e Nova Iorque(NYSE).

As a plus

  • Experience building reports, automations, or analytical dashboards using spreadsheets or similar tools.

  • Supervisionar a operação e manutenção dos sistemas de utilidades: compressores de ar e secadores; caldeiras ; sistemas de água (captação/abastecimento, tratamento e distribuição); rede de gás natural; aquecedor e circuito de óleo térmico; sistemas de vapor nas dependências fabris;

Requisitos e qualificações

O QUE VOCÊ PRECISA TER:

  • Formação em Engenharia (Mecânica, Química, Elétrica ou Automação) ou Tecnólogo com sólida experiência em utilidades industriais;
  • Experiência em operação/manutenção de sistemas de utilidades: compressores, secadores de ar, caldeiras, queimadores, redes de gás natural e sistemas de óleo térmico;

  • Leitura de P&ID, instrumentação e noções de automação (CLP/SDCD, intertravamentos);
  • Vivência com gestão de contratos, CAPEX, KPIs de manutenção e eficiência energética.

Sua energia se destaca mais se você tiver estes itens:

  • Certificação NR-13 (responsável por vasos/caldeiras) e conhecimento em ISO 50001;
  • Experiência nos setores de óleo e gás, químico, alimentos/bebidas ou lubrificantes;
  • Vivência com sistemas de gestão (ISO 14001/9001, SSMA) e metodologias Lean, TPM, RCA, RCM e técnicas preditivas (análise vibracional, termografia, ultrassom).

Nosso processo contempla 3 etapas principais (podem ter outras, e você ficará por dentro caso avance):

title: Analista Comercial
description:
Com experiência em gestão de negócios desde 1955, a WLM atua de forma estratégica e integrada nos segmentos automotivo, do agronegócio, de energia e de soluções sustentáveis, consolidando-se como um grupo sólido, diversificado e em constante evolução.

O principal foco dos negócios da WLM é a comercialização de produtos e serviços da marca Scania, incluindo caminhões pesados e extrapesados, chassis para ônibus rodoviários e urbanos, venda de peças genuínas, além da prestação de serviços de manutenção corretiva e preventiva e assistência técnica especializada.

No segmento de concessionárias Scania , a WLM está presente em mais de 20 pontos no país, atendendo seis estados brasileiros, por meio das operações Equipo (RJ), Itaipu (MG), Itaipu Norte (PA), Quinta Roda (SP) eSupermac(AM e RR).

No segmento do agronegócio , por meio de suas controladasFartura (Sul do Pará) e Itapura (Norte do Mato Grosso, Sul de Minas e região de Campinas/SP) , a WLM atua nas atividades de cria, recria e engorda de bovinos, além da produção e comercialização de café, soja e milho. Com forte compromisso com a sustentabilidade, suas atividades produtivas são executadas com foco nas melhores práticas de preservação da fauna e flora nativas, bem como no cuidado com a água e o solo.

Em 2025, a WLM anunciou a aquisição de 60% da CHP Brasil , empresa referência em geração distribuída e eficiência energética. Com essa aquisição, o grupo amplia sua presença estratégica, diversifica seu portfólio e dá um passo significativo em direção ao futuro, reforçando seu compromisso com a sustentabilidade e com a criação de novas oportunidades de negócio no setor de energia.

Como parte dessa estratégia de inovação, sustentabilidade e diversificação dos negócios, nasce a EkoTruck , uma startup criada dentro do Grupo WLM com o propósito de oferecer sempre a melhor solução em peças e serviços para seus clientes. A empresa expande o foco do grupo por meio da reciclagem de caminhões, da oferta de peças alternativas, componentes remanufaturados e contratos de manutenção, com forte uso de tecnologia. Seu foco principal está na redução do TCO (Custo Total de Propriedade) dos clientes, no fortalecimento da economia circular e na geração de eficiência operacional sustentável.

A localização estratégica das unidades da WLM permite uma atuação com ampla cobertura geográfica, garantindo agilidade, qualidade e excelência no atendimento.

Vem acelerar a sua carreira com o Grupo WLM!

Confira as atribuições e vantagens da vaga de ANALISTA COMERCIAL abaixo e venha fazer parte desse time de sucesso:

Sua missão:

  • Apoiar a tomada de decisão da área comercial com base em dados e indicadores;
  • Desenvolver e estruturar estratégias para fortalecimento da área comercial;
  • Gerenciar estoque em alinhamento com canais de vendas;
  • Desenvolver e implementar estratégias de precificação (pricing);
  • Criar e acompanhar estratégias de vendas;
  • Monitorar indicadores de performance, metas e resultados;
  • Otimizar campanhas comerciais, incluindo precificação dinâmica.

Requisitos:

  • Ensino superior completo em Marketing, Administração, Gestão Comercial ou áreas correlatas;
  • Pacote Office intermediário.
  • Experiência na função.
  • Diferencial vivência no setor automotivo.

Vantagens/Benefícios:

  • Ticket Alimentação - pensado para garantir praticidade no cuidado com a sua casa e família.
  • Refeição no local - para garantir refeições mais práticas e tranquilas no seu dia a dia.
  • Vale Transporte - para apoiar seu deslocamento no trajeto casa x trabalho x casa.
  • Assistência Médica - cuidando da sua saúde e de quem você ama.
  • Assistência Odontológica - cuidando do seu sorriso e de toda a sua família.
  • Cartão Farmácia – facilidade e conveniência para cuidar da sua saúde e bem-estar.
  • Seguro de Vida em Grupo e Assistência Funeral - proteção e segurança para você e sua família em momentos delicados.
  • Wellhub(Gympass) - incentivo à prática de atividades físicas e ao bem-estar.

title: F&B Concessions Coordinator
description:
F&B Concessions Coordinator

Department: Tournament and Venue Operations

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

Working alongside the FIFA/FIFA27 Partnership Rights Delivery (PRD) team and reporting to the FIFA Senior Partner Rights Delivery Manager in Zurich and the FIFA27 Senior F&B Concessions Manager, the F&B Concessions Coordinator supports the operational planning and delivery of the Public Food and Beverage (F&B) Concessions Programme for stadium spectators and fulfillment of FIFA’s Commercial Partners’ contractual rights and obligations across all stadiums at the FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™. The objective is to implement and deliver successfully the FIFA Commercial Partners’ exclusive food & beverage rights.

This position plays an integral part in ensuring a successful tournament through the delivery of FIFA’s commercial operations in the host country. The role operates under the supervision of the FIFA Senior Partner Rights Delivery Manager and the FIFA27 Senior F&B Concessions Manager and does not carry direct commercial ownership or decision-making authority over F&B concessionaire or Commercial Partner agreements.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • The main responsibilities of the F&B Concessions Coordinator for the FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™ encompass supporting the planning, coordination, and operational delivery of the F&B Concessions Programme, including but not limited to:
  • Support the implementation of the Public F&B Concessions Programme across all eight stadiums, including timeline tracking, milestone follow-up, and coordination of deliverables.
  • Assist in integrating Commercial Partner products and services within the F&B Concessions Programme.
  • Support the planning and operational implementation of the commercial rights granted to FIFA’s Commercial Partners within the F&B Concessions Programme.
  • Coordinate with appointed F&B Concessionaire(s), service providers, and internal stakeholders to ensure smooth information flow and execution of services within the F&B Concessions project.
  • Provide administrative and organisational support throughout the F&B concessionaire tender (RFP) and other related F&B related tender processes, including documentation management, evaluation support, reporting and assistance in market research activities.
  • Support the review, mapping, preparation, and optimisation of onsite F&B infrastructure and facilities across all official stadiums, ensuring proper documentation and tracking of action points.
  • Track the development and implementation of F&B concepts and operations, menus, pricing, and onsite infrastructure across all stadiums, ensuring deadlines and requirements are met.
  • Coordinate logistics and administrative preparation for stadium inspections and Commercial Partner operational F&B site visits, preparing documentation and follow-up actions.
  • Support the creation and coordination of F&B-related signage and branding elements (e.g. menu boards).
  • Assist in defining and optimising the service and display of F&B Commercial Partners’ products, supporting alignment between internal and external stakeholders.
  • Prepare reports, presentations, dashboards, and tracking tools using Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Teams, etc.).
  • Assist in developing and maintaining training materials, briefing documents, presentations and operational guidelines.
  • Assist with monitoring daily operations pre-tournament and during tournament time, ensuring proper documentation and reporting.

YOUR PROFILE

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Catering, Hospitality Management, Event Management, Business Administration, or a related field (or equivalent level of education).

Experience

  • 2 - 4 years of professional experience in food & beverage, catering, hospitality, event management, or a related area.
  • Experience supporting F&B concessions or catering operations, ideally within large-scale international events, preferably in the sports industry
  • Exposure to project coordination and administrative support within complex, multi-stakeholder environments.
  • Experience assisting in infrastructure or operational planning is considered an asset.

Skills & Competencies

  • Good understanding of the food & beverage concessions industry; experience in stadium or event environments is an advantage.
  • Basic knowledge of utilities and infrastructure requirements relevant to F&B operations (e.g. electricity, water supply).
  • Understanding of food safety and hygiene standards applicable to F&B operations.
  • Strong organisational and coordination skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities simultaneously.
  • Structured working style with high attention to detail and strong follow-up capabilities.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work effectively in a team environment and under tight timelines.
  • Proactive and solution-oriented mindset with a service-focused approach to commercial rights delivery.

Certification & Requirements

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office tools (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Teams; knowledge of Visio and MS Project is an advantage).
  • Experience using planning software and online collaboration tools.
  • Willingness to travel and work extended hours during peak project phases and tournament time.

Candidate Requirements:

  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Bilingual - Portuguese and English
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro for the duration of the employment (pre-tournament and operational tournament time)

title: ServiceNow Configuration Manager - Tieto Indtech (m/f/d)
description:
Configuration manager - ServiceNow

Are you looking for an opportunity in one of the largest tech companies in the Nordics? We are looking for a proactive and detail-oriented ServiceNow Configuration Manager to take ownership of our Configuration Management process and ensure the quality, accuracy, and reliability of our ServiceNow CMDB. In this key role, you will help strengthen the foundation of our ITSM processes by maintaining auditable configuration data that drives stable operations and informed decision‑making across the organization.

Joining Tieto Indtech, Nexus unit as a ServiceNow Configuration manager

As a Configuration Manager , you will be responsible for leading the governance, data quality, and ongoing development of our ServiceNow CMDB. You will collaborate closely with Process Owners, Product Management, Customer Service functions, and the ServiceNow Platform Owner to ensure that configuration data remains trustworthy, complete, and aligned with our platform strategy and ITSM practices.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who is passionate about structure, accuracy, and continuous improvement — and who enjoys influencing how the organization manages technology information at scale.

Responsibilities:

  • Own the Configuration Management process and ensure the health and quality of CMDB data.
  • Define, develop, and maintain CMDB governance policies, including CI class models, naming conventions, and lifecycle states.
  • Maintain and enhance the CMDB data model, structure, and CI relationships.
  • Ensure configuration data is accurate, complete, compliant, and supports ITSM processes.
  • Collaborate with Incident, Change, Problem, and other Process Owners to ensure correct usage of CI data.
  • Support stakeholders across the organization in product management and customer onboarding activities.
  • Lead CMDB audits and health checks, identifying gaps and driving corrective actions.
  • Define requirements for discovery, integrations, and data population into the CMDB.
  • Serve as the functional lead for CMDB-related tools and integrations in partnership with the ServiceNow Platform Owner.
  • Align configuration management practices with the overall ServiceNow platform strategy, architecture, and roadmap.

To rock this position, you own

  • Strong hands‑on experience with ServiceNow CMDB and configuration management practices.
  • Solid understanding of CMDB structure, CI relationships, lifecycle management , and data modelling.
  • Experience with running ITSM processes in ServiceNow.
  • Knowledge of ITIL and ITSM frameworks.
  • Analytical mindset with strong attention to detail and a drive for data quality.
  • Ability to work collaboratively with cross‑functional teams and stakeholders.
  • Ability to communicate complex information clearly across different teams.

Nice to have:

  • ServiceNow certifications (e.g., CMDB, Discovery, ITOM).
  • Experience of ServiceNow integrations, and data ingestion methods.
  • Experience supporting product onboarding or customer onboarding service processes in ServiceNow.
  • Familiarity with audit and compliance activities related to configuration data.

What’s in it for you?

  • A role with significant ownership and impact on our ITSM and platform strategy.
  • A collaborative environment partnering with skilled professionals across IT and business.
  • Opportunities for growth within the ServiceNow and ITOM ecosystem.
  • A chance to shape how the organization manages essential configuration and service data.
  • We offer a dynamic and challenging work environment where you can grow your skills and advance your career. We are committed to fostering a culture of collaboration, innovation, and customer focus.
  • We offer you professional growth, open culture and an outstanding work‑life balance! We believe that our organizational culture is an important part of enabling you to be successful. We provide a flexible hybrid work model as part of our culture and way of working. Finally, we also believe in curiosity and learning as a lifestyle where you need to unlearn and relearn every day as new possibilities emerge.

We offer:

  • The contract is for an indefinite period of time. We count on you!
  • Work partially or completely remote. Work from wherever it suits you.
  • Extra holidays. We have 25 days off plus 2 sick days.
  • We contribute from 10 400 CZK per year. You name it. Choose from contributions for pension and life insurance, sports, culture, health, travel or education in the cafeteria.
  • Educate yourself. We regularly organise and pay for IT courses, certifications, language training and personal development courses.
  • 123CZK meal allowance on top of your salary.
  • Reward for a new colleague. Refer another colleague to us and get up to 80,000 CZK.
  • We’ll support you when you’re sick. For colleagues who are seriously ill for a long period of time, we contribute to sick pay in excess of the law.
  • Extra work is appreciated. When overtime is needed, we pay more than the law requires.
  • Stay fit and fresh. In Ostrava, use the free fitness facilities in the building, in other locations, do sports with Multisport.
  • Nordic culture. At Tieto, we believe in you. No one is breathing down your neck and checking every minute of your work. We are friendly and open.

About Industry Nexus

Nexus supports its customers in business process automation by exchanging and sharing business information with their business partners. We have two service areas: Business Information eXchange (BIX) and Multichannel.

Nexus has a large existing customer base in the Nordics and is a growing business unit within Tietoevry Industry. With a unique combination of global capabilities and local presence, Nexus currently serves more than 4000 customers in 50+ countries around the world - creating a digital advantage for millions every day.

Join us and make your mark!

We look forward to your application!
Please attach your CV or LinkedIn-profile and we’ll reach out to you. Interviews will be held on a continuous basis, so we encourage you to apply today.

If you have any questions regarding this role, please contact Heli Huuhtanen, Head of Customer Experience Hub, via e-mail

About Tieto

Tieto creates purposeful technology that reinvents the world for good. We are a leading technology company with a strong Nordic heritage and global capabilities. Based on our core values of openness, trust and diversity, we work with our customers to develop digital futures where businesses, societies, and humanity thrive.

Our 24,000 experts globally specialize in cloud, data, and software, serving thousands of enterprises and public‑sector customers in more than 90 countries. Tieto’s annual turnover is approximately EUR 3 billion and the company’s shares are listed on the NASDAQ exchange in Helsinki and Stockholm, as well as on Oslo Bør.

Additional Information

At Tieto, we believe in the power of diversity, equity, and inclusion. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds, genders (m/f/d), and walks of life to join our team, as we believe that this fosters an inspiring workplace and fuels innovation. Our commitment to openness, trust, and diversity is at the heart of our mission to create digital futures that benefit businesses, societies, and humanity.

title: ServiceNow Configuration Manager - Tieto Indtech (m/f/d)
description:
Job Description

Configuration manager - ServiceNow

Are you looking for an opportunity in one of the largest tech companies in the Nordics? We are looking for a proactive and detail-oriented ServiceNow Configuration Manager to take ownership of our Configuration Management process and ensure the quality, accuracy, and reliability of our ServiceNow CMDB. In this key role, you will help strengthen the foundation of our ITSM processes by maintaining auditable configuration data that drives stable operations and informed decision‑making across the organization.

Joining Tieto Indtech, Nexus unit as a ServiceNow Configuration manager

As a Configuration Manager, you will be responsible for leading the governance, data quality, and ongoing development of our ServiceNow CMDB. You will collaborate closely with Process Owners, Product Management, Customer Service functions, and the ServiceNow Platform Owner to ensure that configuration data remains trustworthy, complete, and aligned with our platform strategy and ITSM practices.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who is passionate about structure, accuracy, and continuous improvement — and who enjoys influencing how the organization manages technology information at scale.

Responsibilities

  • Own the Configuration Management process and ensure the health and quality of CMDB data.
  • Define, develop, and maintain CMDB governance policies, including CI class models, naming conventions, and lifecycle states.
  • Maintain and enhance the CMDB data model, structure, and CI relationships.
  • Ensure configuration data is accurate, complete, compliant, and supports ITSM processes.
  • Collaborate with Incident, Change, Problem, and other Process Owners to ensure correct usage of CI data.
  • Support stakeholders across the organization in product management and customer onboarding activities.
  • Lead CMDB audits and health checks, identifying gaps and driving corrective actions.
  • Define requirements for discovery, integrations, and data population into the CMDB.
  • Serve as the functional lead for CMDB-related tools and integrations in partnership with the ServiceNow Platform Owner.
  • Align configuration management practices with the overall ServiceNow platform strategy, architecture, and roadmap.

To rock this position, you own

  • Strong hands‑on experience with ServiceNow CMDB and configuration management practices.
  • Solid understanding of CMDB structure, CI relationships, lifecycle management , and data modelling.
  • Experience with running ITSM processes in ServiceNow .
  • Knowledge of ITIL and ITSM frameworks.
  • Analytical mindset with strong attention to detail and a drive for data quality.
  • Ability to work collaboratively with cross‑functional teams and stakeholders.
  • Ability to communicate complex information clearly across different teams.

Nice to have

  • ServiceNow certifications (e.g., CMDB, Discovery, ITOM).
  • Experience of ServiceNow integrations, and data ingestion methods.
  • Experience supporting product onboarding or customer onboarding service processes in ServiceNow.
  • Familiarity with audit and compliance activities related to configuration data.

What’s in it for you?

  • A role with significant ownership and impact on our ITSM and platform strategy
  • A collaborative environment partnering with skilled professionals across IT and business
  • Opportunities for growth within the ServiceNow and ITOM ecosystem
  • A chance to shape how the organization manages essential configuration and service data
  • We offer a dynamic and challenging work environment where you can grow your skills and advance your career. We are committed to fostering a culture of collaboration, innovation, and customer focus.
  • We offer you professional growth, open culture and an outstanding work‑life balance! We believe that our organizational culture is an important part of enabling you to be successful. We provide a flexible hybrid work model as part of our culture and way of working. Finally, we also believe in curiosity and learning as a lifestyle where you need to unlearn and relearn every day as new possibilities emerge.

About Industry Nexus

Nexus supports its customers in business process automation by exchanging and sharing business information with their business partners. We have two service areas: Business Information eXchange (BIX) and Multichannel.

Nexus has a large existing customer base in the Nordics and is a growing business unit within Tietoevry Industry. With a unique combination of global capabilities and local presence, Nexus currently serves more than 4000 customers in 50+ countries around the world - creating a digital advantage for millions every day.

Join us and make your mark!

We look forward to your application! Please attach your CV or LinkedIn‑profile and we’ll reach out to you. Interviews will be held on a continuous basis, so we encourage you to apply today.

If you have any questions regarding this role, please contact Heli Huuhtanen, Head of Customer Experience Hub, via e‑mail

About Tieto

Tieto creates purposeful technology that reinvents the world for good. We are a leading technology company with a strong Nordic heritage and global capabilities. Based on our core values of openness, trust and diversity, we work with our customers to develop digital futures where businesses, societies, and humanity thrive.

Our 24,000 experts globally specialize in cloud, data, and software, serving thousands of enterprises and public‑sector customers in more than 90 countries. Tieto’s annual turnover is approximately EUR 3 billion and the company’s shares are listed on the NASDAQ exchange in Helsinki and Stockholm, as well as on Oslo Bør.

Additional Information

At Tieto, we believe in the power of diversity, equity, and inclusion. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds, genders (m/f/d), and walks of life to join our team, as we believe that this fosters an inspiring workplace and fuels innovation. Our commitment to openness, trust, and diversity is at the heart of our mission to create digital futures that benefit businesses, societies, and humanity.

description:
Imagine your career taking you to the depths of innovation and the heights of impact. Our people enable continuous progress. Their commitment, collective expertise, and unique capabilities are the engine room behind SBM Offshore’s True. Blue. Transition. - shaping the future of energy, and beyond.

About Us:
SBM Offshore is the world’s deepwater ocean‑infrastructure expert. Our work is already resulting in cleaner, more efficient energy production. True. Blue. Transition. is our promise to enable that into the future while at the same time using our expertise to support new and existing markets in the blue economy. It starts with Advancing our Core: continuing to advance the decarbonization of traditional energy production. While Pioneering More: helping to enable the energy transition and using our unique capabilities in ocean infrastructure to support more industries to grow sustainably. Sharing our experience for a better blue tomorrow.

Purpose

  • The Payroll and Benefits Team Lead is responsible for overseeing the payroll and benefits administration processes in a particular location to ensure accurate, timely, and compliant delivery of employee remuneration and associated benefits. This role requires a strong understanding of payroll regulations, benefits management, and employee satisfaction strategies while fostering alignment with global and local HR policies.

Responsibilities

  • You oversee the endtoend payroll process, ensuring accuracy and compliance with local labor laws, tax regulations, and SBM Offshore policies. You regularly monitor payroll outputs, promptly resolving any discrepancies or issues that arise. You ensure the timely submission of tax filings, social security contributions, and other statutory payments. Additionally, you collaborate with HR, Finance, and external vendors to maintain smooth and efficient payroll operations.
  • You manage various benefits programs, including health insurance, retirement plans, leave policies, and wellness initiatives. You review and suggest updates to benefits offerings to ensure they align with market trends and meet employee needs. You partner with benefits providers to maintain high service levels and cost efficiency, and you effectively communicate benefitsrelated information to employees.
  • You mentor and guide the Payroll and Benefits team, supporting their professional growth and development. You allocate responsibilities, monitor team performance, and address any skill gaps through training and support. You foster a collaborative work environment that aligns with SBM Offshore’s values and goals.
  • You ensure that payroll and benefits processes comply with local and global regulations, internal policies, and audits. You keep current on labor laws, tax regulations, and benefits trends to minimize risks. You support internal and external audits by providing accurate documentation and reports as needed.
  • You continuously identify opportunities to streamline payroll and benefits processes using technology and best practices. You develop and maintain key performance indicators (KPIs), dashboards, and reports for HR and management review. Additionally, you contribute to HR strategic initiatives by providing valuable insights based on payroll and benefits data.

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Accounting, or related field. Payroll or benefitsspecific certifications are advantageous.

Experience

  • Experience in payroll and benefits management, preferably within the oil and gas or offshore industries.
  • Expertise in relevant social security reporting and regulations, ensuring accurate submissions and updates as required by law.
  • Handson experience with payroll systems tailored to local labor laws.
  • Demonstrated leadership and team management skills.
  • Experience working with HRIS and payroll systems (e.g., SAP, Workday).
  • Strong knowledge of local labor laws, tax regulations, and benefits frameworks.
  • Analytical mindset with excellent problemsolving skills.
  • Advanced proficiency in MS Excel and payroll software.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with fluency in English and relevant local language.

Functional Competencies

Tools and data governance Diversity and inclusion Organization change and development Learning and development People engagement Payroll Labour law Change Management Personnel administration

GENERAL INFORMATION

SBM Offshore N.V. is a listed holding company that is headquartered in Amsterdam. It holds direct and indirect interests in other companies that collectively with SBM Offshore N.V. form the SBM Offshore Group (“the Company”). For further information, please visit our website at The companies in which SBM Offshore N.V., directly and indirectly, owns investments are separate entities.

SBM Offshore is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and affirmative action employer. SBM Offshore does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, non‑disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need.

WHY JOIN US

This Lead Java Backend Engineer role plays a critical part in strengthening a scalable backend platform that powers future product growth and new capabilities. MUST HAVES

  • 4+ years of experience as a Software Engineer focused on backend development of scalable services
  • Expert level proficiency in Java
  • Deep experience with frameworks such as Spring Boot or Flask
  • Strong experience with cloud platforms such as AWS or GCP , including serverless technologies, containerization, and managed services
  • Proven ability to design high availability, high performance applications following microservice architecture and RESTful API design
  • Strong understanding of relational databases such as PostgreSQL or MySQL and NoSQL systems such as MongoDB or Redis

NICE TO HAVES

  • SaaS experience is a plus

  • Experience with large scale distributed systems
  • Experience in the healthcare industry or digital media

PERKS AND BENEFITS

  • Professional growth: Mentorship, TechTalks, and personalized growth roadmaps.
  • Competitive compensation: USD-based pay with education, fitness, and team activity budgets.
  • Exciting projects: Modern solutions with Fortune 500 and top product companies.
  • Flextime: Flexible schedule with remote and office options.

It includes main stages: Application → Coding Challenge → Video Interview → Technical Interview or Interview with the Hiring Manager(s). Each step helps us understand your skills and overall fit. If it’s a match, you’ll receive an offer.
