title: Senior Manager, Ocean Policy
description:
Senior Manager, Ocean Policy

Conservation International protects nature for the benefit of humanity. Through science, policy, fieldwork, and finance, we spotlight and secure the most important places in nature for the climate, biodiversity, and for people. With offices in 30 countries and projects in more than 100 countries, Conservation International partners with governments, companies, civil society, Indigenous peoples, and local communities to help people and nature thrive together.

POSITION SUMMARY

This position is open for consideration in the following locations in the Americas, with preference for candidates based in time zones that can accommodate calls with colleagues in Europe and Africa: Arlington-US, Brazil(remote), Colombia, Costa Rica, Ecuador, Guyana, Mexico, Suriname, Peru

Over the last 10 years, CI has developed a comprehensive Blue Climate program spanning over 20 countries dedicated to identifying and addressing science and policy priorities for oceans and climate globally. The Blue Climate program within the Center for Oceans at CI works closely with our field programs across the Americas, Asia-Pacific and Africa to design and implement innovative approaches to (1) implement nature-based climate adaptation solutions that improve coastal and marine communities’ livelihoods and resilience while also conserving ecosystems and biodiversity; and (2) conserve and restore coastal blue carbon ecosystems (mangroves, salt marshes, and seagrass meadows) for climate change mitigation. The Blue Climate program also has key leadership roles in advancing climate mitigation and adaptation priorities into national and regional coastal management and science through the International Blue Carbon Institute, Blue Carbon Initiative, the International Partnership for Blue Carbon, the Global Mangrove Alliance and the Global Green-Gray Community of Practice, and policy with the Center for Policy and Incentives.

Under the supervision of the Director, Ocean Policy, the Senior Manager, Ocean Policy, is a self-motivated, creative team member integral to the long-term growth and success of CI’s Blue Climate program and Ocean Policy team. The Senior Manager, Ocean Policy will support the development, implementation and management of strategic international policy‑based approaches and programs to achieve CI’s Ocean Policy goals spanning coastal resilience, climate mitigation, green‑gray infrastructure, blue carbon ecosystems and ocean‑climate integration. Together with the Director, Ocean Policy, they will work with CI’s Center for Policy and Incentives to ensure alignment with CI’s larger international and national policy programs and priorities, including providing technical inputs and guidance on ocean‑climate issues. The position will also work closely with teams across CI including other programs within the Center for Oceans and the Moore Center for Science and Solutions to ensure alignment and integration of ocean policy priorities with all related CI programs and topic areas, including biodiversity, finance, and community fisheries.

RESPONSIBILITIES

International Ocean Policy

  • Manage strategic policy initiatives to achieve CI’s Ocean Policy goals spanning coastal resilience, green‑gray infrastructure, blue carbon, and other ocean‑climate areas which integrate and align international and national policy goals.
  • Work closely with CI’s Center for Policy and Incentives to ensure ocean‑climate strategies and approaches are aligned with international and national policy programs and priorities.
  • Play a key role in project development, fundraising, implementation, communications, and broader capacity building for the Ocean Policy program.
  • Contribute to the drafting and revision of CI ocean policy positions, policy briefs, guidance documents, and other technical resources.
  • Play a key role in representing the Center for Oceans within the CI delegation to international policy meetings related to climate, biodiversity, and oceans, such as the UNFCCC climate COP and intersessional meetings. Additionally, support CI’s strategic engagement in these spaces (e.g., side events, meetings with countries and partners).
  • Support the development and management of relationships and partnerships with government representatives and like‑minded organizations to accelerate and achieve CI ocean policy objectives in close coordination with CI’s international policy team and relevant country programs.

Ocean Policy Advancement in Priority Countries

  • In partnership with CI country programs, the International Blue Carbon Institute, and the Center for Policy and Incentives, support the development and implementation of national or regional ocean policy objectives and programs which are aligned with and inform CI’s Blue Climate and broader policy priorities.
  • Provide CI programs and partners with strategic support, technical expertise, and/or capacity building for the integration of coastal ecosystems into Nationally Determined Contributions and implementation plans, national climate and ocean policy, greenhouse gas inventories, NBSAPs and other related components of ocean‑climate policy.
  • As needed, facilitate in‑person and virtual meetings, workshops, and related events with national governments and local partners to advance the priorities of CI country programs in alignment with national objectives.
  • Support the Ocean Policy Director in scoping new policy activities in accordance with existing CI programs.

Blue Climate Program

  • Contribute to strategy development, planning processes, fundraising, team initiatives/special projects, reporting and communication efforts as needed.
  • Coordinate with other teams across the Blue Climate network team to ensure programmatic alignment and synergies between CI projects.

Other duties as assigned by supervisor.

WORKING CONDITIONS

  • Frequent international travel (25% or more) is required.
  • Ability to work in remote locations or under difficult working conditions.
  • This position follows a hybrid work structure, working some days from the office and some days remotely. Guidance will be shared during the interview process.
  • Requires working remotely with colleagues in other locations and time zones.
  • Flexible working hours: Frequent early morning and evening meetings, and occasional work over weekends, to accommodate colleagues in other time zones or high‑level policy events.
  • This position follows a hybrid work structure, working some days from the office and some remotely. Guidance will be shared during the interview process.

QUALIFICATIONS

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree
  • 5 to 7 years of experience working in international climate and/or ocean policy mechanisms and fora.
  • Understanding of government processes and the overall policy engagement environment.
  • Strong organization, project management, and prioritization skills.
  • Excellent time management skills and ability to adapt in a fast‑paced, changing environment.
  • Ability to work both independently and as part of a diverse, international team.
  • Experience partnering with, and influencing, key stakeholders and building strong partnerships across public and private sectors and civil society.
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills, and ability to effectively communicate complex information to a diverse audience.
  • Enthusiasm and capacity for learning scientific and related basis for specific conservation outcomes as needed to support policy priorities and processes.
  • Fluency in written and spoken English.

Preferred

  • Bi‑lingual or multilingual in official UN languages.
  • Expertise in coastal blue carbon and marine ecosystems, climate change science, and/or nature‑based solutions
  • Master's degree or other advanced degree in environmental policy or related field.
  • Experience working globally in a range of cultural settings.

description:
Com experiência em gestão de negócios desde 1955, aWLM atua de forma estratégica e integrada nos segmentos automotivo, do agronegócio, de energia e de soluções sustentáveis, consolidando-se como um grupo sólido, diversificado e em constante evolução.

O principal foco dos negócios da WLM é a comercialização de produtos e serviços da marca Scania, incluindo caminhões pesados e extrapesados, chassis para ônibus rodoviários e urbanos, venda de peças genuínas, além da prestação de serviços de manutenção corretiva e preventiva e assistência técnica especializada.

No segmento deconcessionárias Scania , a WLM está presente em mais de 20 pontos no país, atendendo seis estados brasileiros, por meio das operaçõesEquipo (RJ), Itaipu (MG), Itaipu Norte (PA), Quinta Roda (SP) eSupermac(AM e RR).

No segmento doagronegócio , por meio de suas controladasFartura (Sul do Pará) e Itapura (Norte do Mato Grosso, Sul de Minas e região de Campinas/SP) , a WLM atua nas atividades de cria, recria e engorda de bovinos, além da produção e comercialização de café, soja e milho. Com forte compromisso com a sustentabilidade, suas atividades produtivas são executadas com foco nas melhores práticas de preservação da fauna e flora nativas, bem como no cuidado com a água e o solo.

Em 2025, a WLM anunciou a aquisição de 60% daCHP Brasil , empresa referência em geração distribuída e eficiência energética. Com essa aquisição, o grupo amplia sua presença estratégica, diversifica seu portfólio e dá um passo significativo em direção ao futuro, reforçando seu compromisso com a sustentabilidade e com a criação de novas oportunidades de negócio no setor de energia.

Como parte dessa estratégia de inovação, sustentabilidade e diversificação dos negócios, nasce aEkoTruck , uma startup criada dentro do Grupo WLM com o propósito de oferecer sempre a melhor solução em peças e serviços para seus clientes. A empresa expande o foco do grupo por meio da reciclagem de caminhões, da oferta de peças alternativas, componentes remanufaturados e contratos de manutenção, com forte uso de tecnologia. Seu foco principal está na redução do TCO (Custo Total de Propriedade) dos clientes, no fortalecimento da economia circular e na geração de eficiência operacional sustentável.

A localização estratégica das unidades da WLM permite uma atuação com ampla cobertura geográfica, garantindo agilidade, qualidade e excelência no atendimento.

A holding do grupo está localizada no Rio de Janeiro e conta com uma filial corporativa em Contagem/MG.

Vem acelerar a sua carreira com o Grupo WLM!

Sua missão:

. Elabora desempeno de chassis, planos de manutenção; realiza manutenções de motores, sistemas e partes de veículos automotores.

. Substitui peças, repara e testa desempenho de componentes e sistemas de veículos.

General Manager

The Opportunity

We are seeking a transformational General Manager to lead and expand a well-established operation within the energy services sector in Brazil.

This is not a maintenance role. This is a growth mandate.

The selected executive will take full ownership of the country P&L, drive operational excellence, strengthen culture, and lead the next phase of strategic expansion. The goal is clear: double revenue within three years while maintaining uncompromising safety and performance standards.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic & Business Leadership

  • Full P&L responsibility for the country operation.
  • Develop and execute a robust business plan to ensure sustainable growth, profitability, and market share expansion.
  • Continuously assess market dynamics, competitive landscape, and client needs to identify new business opportunities.
  • Act as the senior representative of the company with key clients, partners, regulators, and industry stakeholders.

Operational Excellence

  • Lead the HSE culture aligned with the highest industry standards.

Technical Expertise

  • Strong and proven experience in Oil & Gas Services

description:
Descrição da vaga

ASPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas,Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Reconhecemos que nosso sucesso depende da variedade de perspectivas que cada um de nossos colaboradores agrega à Bunge. Estamos empenhados em promover práticas para nutrir uma cultura de pertencimento para todos. Globalmente, apoiamos os Princípios de Empoderamento das Mulheres, de ONU Mulheres. No Brasil, somos associados ao Mover - Movimento pela Equidade Racial, e fomos eleitos pela ferramenta global Disability Index Report® como um dos melhores locais para se trabalhar em relação à inclusão de pessoas com deficiência. Atuamos continuamente em prol de nosso compromisso de deixar um legado positivo em todas as comunidades onde atuamos.

title: Quality Assurance Engineer – Tieto Tech Consulting (m/f/d)
description:
Job Description

Do you have a strong background in quality assurance, a structured approach to testing, and want to join one of the largest technology companies in the Nordics? Then this is the role for you.

We are looking for a Quality Assurance Engineer who wants to be part of Tieto Tech Consulting . Tieto Tech Consulting works as a true partner, solving clients’ toughest technology challenges and delivering reliable outcomes that drive measurable results. By combining engineering excellence with disciplined quality practices, we support customers developing and operating critical digital platforms.

In this role, you will work in close collaboration with product, engineering, and design teams, ensuring high quality, reliability, and scalability of backend services in a modern cloud-based environment.

When joining Tieto Tech Consulting as a Quality Assurance Engineer, you will

  • Partner with product, engineering, and design teams to refine user stories, ensuring acceptance criteria are clear, complete, and testable.
  • Conduct daily evaluations of the QA swimlane in JIRA for new feature work and collaborate with engineers to execute test cycles.
  • Design, develop, and document comprehensive test plans and test cases for new and existing backend services.
  • Develop and maintain Postman API tests and automated integration test suites targeting backend services and data flows across AWS components (SQS, SNS, DynamoDB, EventBridge).
  • Implement and manage API contract testing to validate integrations and ensure data consistency across internal and external services.
  • Design, execute, and maintain performance, load, and stress tests for critical backend infrastructure to ensure scalability and reliability.
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to define and test security, access control, and compliance requirements (e.g. HIPAA) for backend services handling sensitive data.
  • Integrate automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions) to establish continuous quality gates and support safe, frequent deployments.
  • Manage initial release completion, acting as the first quality gate by approving tickets when testing passes or returning them for rework when defects are identified.
  • Collaborate with QA Engineers across squads to ensure a consistent and high-quality experience for both patient- and provider-facing features.

Who we are looking for

  • Experienced QA professional with 5+ years of experience in startup or fast-paced environments, combining strong manual testing skills with automated testing capabilities.
  • At least 3 years of hands-on experience testing AWS-based backend architectures using Kubernetes.
  • Strong understanding of testing patterns for distributed systems and AWS services such as SQS, SNS, DynamoDB, and EventBridge .
  • Proficiency in a modern programming language such as Python, Java, or TypeScript for writing and maintaining automated test suites.
  • Proven experience designing and implementing automated integration, end-to-end, and component tests .
  • Experience with performance, load, and stress testing applied to backend infrastructure.
  • Hands-on experience with API contract testing frameworks .
  • Working knowledge of CI/CD principles and experience integrating automated tests into deployment pipelines.
  • Familiarity with agile development practices and bug tracking tools (e.g. JIRA, BrowserStack ).
  • Strong analytical mindset with a continuous improvement approach.
  • Detail-oriented in test execution and thorough in documentation.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively within cross-functional teams.

Experience in the healthcare domain is considered an advantage.

As a person, you are a team player who takes responsibility for quality, works in a structured and disciplined manner, and communicates clearly. You value accuracy, reliability, and continuous improvement in everything you do.

We offer

We offer professional growth, meaningful projects, an open culture, and a strong work-life balance. You will have the opportunity to work in a growing and future-oriented sector, contributing to high-impact digital solutions. We provide a hybrid work model as part of our culture and way of working, and we believe in curiosity and continuous learning as technology evolves.

Location

Asunción, Paraguay (Hybrid)

We perform background checks on all final candidates. Tieto declines calls from recruitment companies.

Additional Information

At Tieto, we believe in the power of diversity, equity, and inclusion. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds, genders (m/f/d), and walks of life to join our team, as we believe that this fosters an inspiring workplace and fuels innovation. Our commitment to openness, trust, and diversity is at the heart of our mission to create digital futures that benefit businesses, societies, and humanity.

Procuramos pessoas que sejam apaixonadas por mudanças, que tenham vontade de aprender e queiram crescer no mercado financeiro. Se você se identifica, venha fazer parte do nosso time!

Uma história de mais de 60 anos de solidez e inovação.

Em 1961 foi fundado o Banco Sofisa, em uma jornada de transformação, adaptação e principalmente inovação.

Hoje, temos orgulho em ser um dos principais bancos do Brasil. O motivo disso é incentivar e acreditar no empreendedor brasileiro, fortalecendo relacionamentos apoiados na ética e no respeito. Um dos fatores que nos destacam no mercado é o comprometimento dos nossos colaboradores, com forte espírito empreendedor e uma paixão que os fazem vestir a camisa como se fossem donos. É essa mesma motivação que nos leva a prêmios e conquistas notáveis, como o de Melhor Banco do Brasil, em um ranking realizado pela Forbes, no ano de 2023.

Por aqui, não nos contentamos com o status quo. Acreditamos que sempre podemos melhorar, aprender, investir e buscar o novo. A melhora contínua é um processo diário. Em 2011, inauguramos uma nova categoria de serviços bancários no Brasil, lançando o primeiro banco digital de investimentos: o Sofisa Direto. Com isso, encontramos a oportunidade ideal para manter os nossos clientes motivados a buscar os seus objetivos. Em toda a história, os negócios do Banco Sofisa foram construídos por uma sólida estrutura financeira, assegurada por altos índices de capitalização, fazendo com que os nossos clientes sintam-se seguros, investindo em ativos de qualidade, que muitas das vezes só se encontram por aqui.

Hoje, podemos dizer que vencemos o maior de todos os testes, o teste do tempo. E se esse teste foi vencido, é porque valorizamos quem realmente importa: você, nosso cliente. Cada obstáculo superado, cada desafio vencido são os fundamentos da solidez e a experiência que precisamos para seguir em frente.

Somos uma empresa 100% digital, com tecnologia desenvolvida localmente e líder no mercado de compra e venda online. Nos tornamos a marca que melhor representa a economia circular no país.

Hoje contamos com dois escritórios nas cidades de Rio de Janeiro e São Paulo. Nosso modelo de trabalho flexível oferece autonomia e liberdade para que nossas pessoas elaborem seus padrões e rotinas com disciplina e protagonismo na conexão com negócio, as prioridades e o propósito da empresa.

Construir um ambiente diverso, inclusivo e comprometido com a equidade faz parte do nosso DNA. Entendemos que diversidade, equidade e inclusão são essenciais para criarmos um ambiente seguro com entregas inovadoras e eficientes para nossas pessoas e sociedade.

Main responsibilities

Se você gosta de aprender e quer fazer parte desse desafio, essa oportunidade é a sua chance. Nessa posição de Data Science Specialist I , você vai somar ao time Data Science que tem como objetivo construir soluções de dados para evoluir experiência do usuário e métricas de negócio de forma escalável.

No dia a dia você vai:

  • Construir e manter pipelines completos de treinamento, versionamento, testes e deploy de modelos de ML
  • Implementar práticas de MLOps para automação, monitoramento e manutenção de modelos em produção
  • Gerenciar ambientes, contêineres, GPUs, escalabilidade e orquestração de recursos
  • Atuar em parceria com Cientistas de IA para transformar experimentos em soluções produtivas
  • Garantir observabilidade dos modelos, monitorando drift, performance, custo, logs e métricas
  • Criar infraestrutura de experimentação e padronizar fluxos de desenvolvimento de IA
  • Suportar segurança, governança e boas práticas na gestão do ciclo de vida dos modelos

Requirements and skills

E o que você precisa ter?

  • Experiência com pipelines de ML/MLOps, CI/CD (Github Actions) e ferramentas como Kubeflow, MLflow, Airflow, AWS Sagemaker
  • Conhecimento em containers (Docker), Kubernetes, APIs e Python
  • Vivência em ambientes Cloud (AWS, GCP ou Azure)
  • Forte entendimento de modelos de Machine Learning

Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com modelagem e manipulação de dados em larga escala
  • Experiência com processamento e deploy de modelos em tempo real/NRT

Additional information

Mais sobre o Grupo OLX:

No Brasil desde 2010, o Grupo OLX tem como propósito empoderar as pessoas para que alcancem seus sonhos, reinventando o modelo de consumo. Com a aquisição do Grupo ZAP, concluída em outubro de 2020, a companhia opera a OLX, plataforma horizontal com posição de liderança nas categorias de automóveis, bens de consumo usados e imóveis; e duas plataformas líderes do mercado imobiliário, ZAP e Viva Real.

Olemme läsnä kaikissa Tietoevryn toimipaikoissa Suomessa: Espoossa, Tampereella, Jyväskylässä, Kuopiossa, Lappeenrannassa, Oulussa ja Turussa. Voit mahdollisuuksien mukaan työskennellä myös muilta paikkakunnilta käsin (asiakastoimituksesta riippuen).

Aqui, cada detalhe é pensado para melhorar a vida das pessoas. Nossa cultura prioriza o relacionamento humano, o desenvolvimento contínuo e a adaptação às novidades do mercado. Valorizamos a proatividade, a excelência no atendimento e a capacidade de adaptar‑se e crescer em um ambiente dinâmico. Nossos colaboradores são incentivados a desenvolver suas habilidades e a buscar novas oportunidades de crescimento dentro da organização.

Atividades

Responsabilidades

  • Gerenciar o atendimento presencial e via telefone, seguindo protocolos estabelecidos.

  • Alcançar metas de vendas e performance.
  • Fornecer feedbacks de melhoria para operação e infraestrutura da unidade.
  • Processar processos de autorização e validação de consultas e exames junto aos planos de saúde.

Conhecendo um pouco mais sobre o grupo Limppano S/A.

Conhecendo um pouco mais sobre o grupo Limppano S/A. Somos um time que cuidamos da limpeza do seu lar gerando bem-estar, no qual combinamos determinação e comprometimento para entregarmos produtos de qualidade. Entendemos que para obtermos os melhores resultados, precisamos dos melhores profissionais. Estamos à procura de talentos que sejam criativos, inovadores e ousados na busca por conhecimento, que tragam resultados sustentáveis ao Grupo Limppano.

Se você tem prazer em contribuir, gosta do que faz e é focado em resultados essa VAGA é para VOCÊ!

Responsabilidades e atribuições

PRINCIPAIS ATIVIDADES:

  • Reposição de Produtos: abastecer o ponto natural da categoria (gôndolas) e pontos extras negociados ou conquistados (ilhas, terminais, pontas de gôndolas, “orelhas”, entre outros) de acordo com as diretrizes da Limppano, evitando rupturas e respeitando o FIFO (primeiro que vence é o primeiro que sai).
  • Exposição e Organização: garantir que os produtos estejam organizados e alinhados com o planograma da empresa.
  • Montagem de Pontos Extras: instalar materiais promocionais (MPDV) e montar exposições sazonais, campanhas e ações promocionais.
  • Precificação: verificar e corrigir preços nos produtos e nas gôndolas conforme as informações da loja ou da empresa. Implementar as etiquetas de preços no PDV.
  • Controle de Estoque: acompanhar o estoque na área de vendas e no depósito do PDV para evitar falta ou excesso de mercadoria.
  • Negociação de Espaços: conquistar espaços extras através de negociação com o gerente ou responsável pelo setor da loja, buscando melhor visibilidade para os produtos.
  • Coleta de Informações: realizar (via aplicativo Involves) pesquisas de preço, presença de produtos, espaço em gôndola, implementação de MPDV, abertura de caixas, ações da concorrência, condições de exposição, entre outros, de acordo com a necessidade do momento (informações da Limppano e da concorrência).

description:
Buscamos um(a) Gerente de Qualidade, Pesquisa e Desenvolvimento (PD) para garantir a excelência e a conformidade dos produtos, atuando como barreira crítica de segurança da produção . Essa posição assegura que somente itens dentro de especificação avancem no processo, com rastreabilidade, evidências e registros completos , liderando a rotina do Controle de Qualidade Laboratorial e apoiando melhorias técnicas e frentes de PD.

Na prática, sua rotina costuma ser assim:

  • Inspeção de recebimento: garantir a execução de testes físico-químicos em matéria-prima e embalagens, com emissão de laudo de aprovação ou laudo de rejeição antes do descarregamento.
  • Liberação de linha e lote: coordenar coletas e análises durante o processo produtivo, assegurando a liberação documentada de cada lote produzido.
  • Bloqueio de não conformidade: identificar desvios em tempo real e executar bloqueio imediato da linha ou do lote, com registro fotográfico e sistêmico, acionando a liderança de operações.
  • Controle de retenção: organizar e catalogar o banco de amostras de retenção diária, garantindo 100% de cobertura por lote e fácil localização para rastreabilidade.
  • Gestão de equipamentos: assegurar rotina de calibração e limpeza dos equipamentos do laboratório, com checklist de aferição registrado no início de cada turno.
  • Gestão da rotina de Qualidade e PD: direcionar prioridades, garantir cumprimento de procedimentos, disciplina de registros/evidências e suporte técnico às necessidades do processo/produto.
  • Documentação e padrões: apoiar manutenção/atualização de POPs, formulários e registros do laboratório, garantindo conformidade e rastreabilidade.
  • Segurança e 5S: reforçar práticas de EPI, manuseio, descarte e organização do laboratório.

Requisitos

  • Formação técnica ou superior em Química ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência em Controle de Qualidade Laboratorial (rotina, liberação, rastreabilidade e registros).
  • Perfil de liderança para tomada de decisão e postura firme em bloqueios e tratativas.

Diferenciais

  • Vivência com tratativas de não conformidade e investigação de desvios (ex.: OOS/OOT).
  • Experiência com estruturação de padrões, checklists e rotina de evidências/registros.
  • Atuação com melhorias de processo e suporte técnico a iniciativas de desenvolvimento (PD).

description:
About The Role

We are looking for a Technical Process Support Engineer with a strong commercial mindset and solid process engineering experience within the oil and gas industry.

This role combines topside process engineering expertise with the ability to identify optimization opportunities, assess production assets, and translate technical diagnostics into value-generating business solutions for clients.

The professional will evaluate onshore and offshore production units, conduct technical audits, identify operational bottlenecks, and propose innovative, economically viable solutions focused on asset optimization.

Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct technical and operational audits of oil and gas production assets.
  • Assess process performance, identify bottlenecks, and uncover optimization opportunities.
  • Perform independent process diagnostics on onshore and offshore units (FPSOs, fixed platforms, and onshore facilities).
  • Translate technical findings into structured value propositions and improvement initiatives.
  • Develop optimization roadmaps focused on operational efficiency and economic return.
  • Support aftermarket services, brownfield projects, and topside modifications.
  • Interface directly with Operations, Engineering teams, suppliers, and clients to gain firsthand familiarity of customer needs plus product applications.
  • Provide technical support during commissioning, start‑up, ramp‑up, and operational phases (desirable).
  • Provides qualified technical sales support to sales team for marketing and sales activities, and to Operations for technical support as required.
  • Evaluate customer support issues as well as maintain top level positive perception by customers pertinent to organization support structure.
  • Prepare technical samples, designs along with presentations to provide supportive technical data as per customer needs.
  • Participate in sales support related conferences, trade shows, workshops plus meetings to update on current information plus developments in industry.

Minimum Requirements

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Production Engineering, or related disciplines.

Experience

  • Proven experience as a Process Engineer within the oil and gas industry.
  • Experience working onboard offshore units and/or onshore production facilities.
  • Background in process audits, performance evaluation, and operational efficiency analysis.

Core Technical Knowledge

  • Oil, gas, and water separation systems.
  • Strong expertise in managing gas production operations and processes: topside, refining, downstrime, production platforms.
  • Gas treatment systems (H₂S/CO₂ removal via amine or membrane systems, dehydration, compression).
  • Produced water treatment systems.
  • Heat exchangers, pressure vessels, filtration systems, and utilities.
  • Familiarity with amine systems, membranes, fixed‑bed scavengers, and hybrid process configurations.
  • Experience in aftermarket services and brownfield environments.
  • Knowledge of oil and gas industry standards (API, ASME, NORSOK – desirable).
  • Strong interest in commercial activity, sales, and expanding business opportunities.
  • Process Simulation Software Expertise: Aspen HYSYS

Languages

  • Advanced English (mandatory).
  • Fluent Portuguese (mandatory).

We are building a platform that merges real-time physics, structured knowledge, and autonomous intelligence. You will be the technical anchor for a team of Senior Engineers handling:

What You’ll Do

  • Code & Quality Standards : Enforce high standards across the stack. You will review API designs (FastAPI), ensure the Frontend maintains strict Component Architecture, and verify that Data pipelines implement appropriate quality gates.

Good to Have

  • Streaming : Proficiency with Streaming Technologies (Kafka, Flink, Spark) and Time-Series Databases (TimescaleDB, InfluxDB).

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities / The Technology Stack

  • Backend : Python 3.12+ (FastAPI), Kafka, Neo4j, LangGraph.
  • Frontend : Angular 16+, TypeScript, RxJS, Plotly.js.
  • Data : Apache Airflow, Delta Lake, Polars/Spark.

Desired Profile

  • The Architect‑Implementer : You can draw the system architecture on a whiteboard, but you are not afraid to open an IDE to debug a failing pipeline or a slow query.

title: Incident Investigator - Relocate to Saudi Arabia, Permanent Expat Relocation Package
description:
This position requires full relocation to Saudi Arabia. It is a permanent full time Expat Relocation Package.

Job Overview

We are seeking an Industrial Incident Investigator to join Loss Prevention Organization (LP)

LP is responsible for providing both day-to-day in-field occupational and process safety support to Saudi Aramco operations, as well as centralized technical support and consulting function. Our field offices are located in Abqaiq, Riyadh, Ras Tanura, Dhahran, Udhailiyah, Jeddah (including Yanbu and Jazan), and Tanajib. Through these offices, LP provides its services to all Saudi Aramco facilities and departments that are located throughout the Kingdom.

Your primary role is to help investigate industrial incidents (fires, major leaks, hydrocarbon explosions, etc.), identify proper root causes, and the actions necessary to prevent recurrence. This includes preparing draft and final incident reports, as well as providing long term support to address all recommendations.

Key Responsibilities

As the successful candidate you will be required to perform the following:

  • Investigate industrial incidents, especially ones with high consequences and understand the hazards related to industrial facilities and their relevant controls.
  • Identify, preserve, and examine incident evidence using widely accepted forensic science principles.
  • Support investigation teams by ensuring proper investigation techniques are understood and used.
  • Conduct through investigations using appropriate investigative tools for the incident in question. Understand incident causation and impact of human factors.
  • Develop and/or thoroughly review all draft incident investigation reports and complete all stages of review.
  • Identify recommendations that should be shared globally for corporate wide implementation.
  • Develop lessons learned and safety alerts/bulletins to communicate actions to prevent recurrence.
  • Educate employees, contractors, and others, to ensure timely communication of lessons learned.
  • Develop and review corporate safety guidance on incident investigations.
  • You will hold a Bachelor degree in Engineering or Engineering Technology from an Accredited Institution,
  • You will have 10 years of experience investigating high consequence (major) industrial incidents, as well as a deep understanding of the various tools and techniques currently utilized to conduct such investigations.
  • You will have an excellent ability to communicate in English with peers as well as members of management, and be able to produce clear and concise oral and written reports in English.

Our high-performing employees are drawn by the challenging and rewarding professional, technical and industrial opportunities we offer, and are remunerated accordingly.

At Aramco, our people work on truly world-scale projects, supported by investment in capital and technology that is second to none. And because, as a global energy company, we are faced with addressing some of the world’s biggest technical, logistical and environmental challenges, we invest heavily in talent development.

We have a proud history of educating and training our workforce over many decades. Employees at all levels are encouraged to improve their sector-specific knowledge and competencies through our workforce development programs – one of the largest in the world.

Aramco energizes the world economy.

Aramco occupies a special position in the global energy industry. We are one of the world’s largest producers of hydrocarbon energy and chemicals, with among the lowest Upstream carbon intensities of any major producer.

With our significant investment in technology and infrastructure, we strive to maximize the value of the energy we produce for the world along with a commitment to enhance Aramco’s value to society.

Headquartered in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, and with offices around the world, we combine market discipline with a generations’ spanning view of the future, born of our nine decades experience as responsible stewards of the Kingdom’s vast hydrocarbon resources. This responsibility has driven us to deliver significant societal and economic benefits to not just the Kingdom, but also to a vast number of communities, economies, and countries that rely on the vital and reliable energy that we supply.

We are one of the most profitable companies in the world, as well as amongst the top five global companies by market capitalization.

title: F&B Concessions Coordinator
description:
Department

Tournament and Venue Operations

Location

Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

The Position

Working alongside the FIFA/FIFA27 Partnership Rights Delivery (PRD) team and reporting to the FIFA Senior Partner Rights Delivery Manager in Zurich and the FIFA27 Senior F&B Concessions Manager, the F&B Concessions Coordinator supports the operational planning and delivery of the Public Food and Beverage (F&B) Concessions Programme for stadium spectators and fulfillment of FIFA’s Commercial Partners’ contractual rights and obligations across all stadiums at the FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™. The objective is to implement and deliver successfully the FIFA Commercial Partners’ exclusive food & beverage rights. This position plays an integral part in ensuring a successful tournament through the delivery of FIFA’s commercial operations in the host country. The role operates under the supervision of the FIFA Senior Partner Rights Delivery Manager and the FIFA27 Senior F&B Concessions Manager and does not carry direct commercial ownership or decision‑making authority over F&B concessionaire or Commercial Partner agreements.

Key Responsibilities

  • The main responsibilities of the F&B Concessions Coordinator for the FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™ encompass supporting the planning, coordination, and operational delivery of the F&B Concessions Programme, including but not limited to:
  • Support the implementation of the Public F&B Concessions Programme across all eight stadiums, including timeline tracking, milestone follow‑up, and coordination of deliverables.
  • Assist in integrating Commercial Partner products and services within the F&B Concessions Programme.
  • Support the planning and operational implementation of the commercial rights granted to FIFA’s Commercial Partners within the F&B Concessions Programme.
  • Coordinate with appointed F&B Concessionaire(s), service providers, and internal stakeholders to ensure smooth information flow and execution of services within the F&B Concessions project.
  • Provide administrative and organisational support throughout the F&B concessionaire tender (RFP) and other related F&B related tender processes, including documentation management, evaluation support, reporting and assistance in market research activities.
  • Support the review, mapping, preparation, and optimisation of onsite F&B infrastructure and facilities across all official stadiums, ensuring proper documentation and tracking of action points.
  • Track the development and implementation of F&B concepts and operations, menus, pricing, and onsite infrastructure across all stadiums, ensuring deadlines and requirements are met.
  • Coordinate logistics and administrative preparation for stadium inspections and Commercial Partner operational F&B site visits, preparing documentation and follow‑up actions.
  • Support the creation and coordination of F&B-related signage and branding elements (e.g. menu boards).
  • Assist in defining and optimising the service and display of F&B Commercial Partners’ products, supporting alignment between internal and external stakeholders.
  • Prepare reports, presentations, dashboards, and tracking tools using Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Teams, etc.).
  • Assist in developing and maintaining training materials, briefing documents, presentations and operational guidelines.
  • Assist with monitoring daily operations pre‑tournament and during tournament time, ensuring proper documentation and reporting.

Your Profile

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Catering, Hospitality Management, Event Management, Business Administration, or a related field (or equivalent level of education).

Experience

  • 2 - 4 years of professional experience in food & beverage, catering, hospitality, event management, or a related area.
  • Experience supporting F&B concessions or catering operations, ideally within large‑scale international events, preferably in the sports industry.
  • Exposure to project coordination and administrative support within complex, multi‑stakeholder environments.
  • Experience assisting in infrastructure or operational planning is considered an asset.

Skills & Competencies

  • Good understanding of the food & beverage concessions industry; experience in stadium or event environments is an advantage.
  • Basic knowledge of utilities and infrastructure requirements relevant to F&B operations (e.g. electricity, water supply).
  • Understanding of food safety and hygiene standards applicable to F&B operations.
  • Strong organisational and coordination skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities simultaneously.
  • Structured working style with high attention to detail and strong follow‑up capabilities.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work effectively in a team environment and under tight timelines.
  • Proactive and solution‑oriented mindset with a service‑focused approach to commercial rights delivery.

Certification & Requirements

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office tools (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Teams; knowledge of Visio and MS Project is an advantage).
  • Experience using planning software and online collaboration tools.
  • Willingness to travel and work extended hours during peak project phases and tournament time.

Candidate Requirements

  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Bilingual – Portuguese and English.
  • Ability to re‑locate to Rio de Janeiro for the duration of the employment (pre‑tournament and operational tournament time).

Technology

Brazil

  • Overseeing a diverse portfolio of technology contracts, ensuring adherence to contractual obligations and performance standards.

  • Responsible for ensuring the execution of contracts follow the appropriate workflows via DocuSign.

Education

  • University degree or equivalent high education.

Qualification

  • Proven track record in managing and implementing Governance Processes.
  • Extensive experience in running KPI/SLA driven engagement.
  • Significant commercial and contract management experience.

  • Strong understanding of suppliers and contract management.
  • Industry knowledge and experience or understanding of the structure and organization of utilities and their core activities.
  • Highly adept at consulting, negotiating, communicating, consensus building and facilitation.
  • Strong political acumen and adaptable to a wide range of working environments.

Experience

  • Minimum of 8 years overall technology contract management experience and minimum 2 years of experience in a similar role
  • Experience in the sports / major event industry
  • Proven track record of managing complex and high spend technology contracts across tier one telecoms and network providers

Skills & Competencies

  • Excellent teamwork and leadership skills
  • Excellent written, verbal, and active listening communication skills
  • Excellent organizational and time management skillsConflict resolution skills are a must.
  • Proven ability to influence cross-functional teams without formal authority.

  • Sharp analytical and problem-solving skills
  • High sense of accountability, trustworthiness, and ethics.
  • Customer and results oriented.

Certifications & Requirements

  • Native or Fluent in Portuguese
  • Proficiency in any other FIFA language (FR / ES / GER) is an asset
  • Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project) and planning software and online collaboration tools

Welcome to PXGEO

PXGEO is an innovative marine geophysical service provider combining the strengths of ocean bottom and towed streamer seismic data acquisition techniques to deliver seamless subsurface imaging for a sustainable future.

What’s the role?

This position will lead and manage the Environment, Health, Safety, and Quality (EHSQ) programs across operations in Brazil, ensuring compliance with national regulations (NR 1-38), international standards (ISO 45001, ISO 14001, ISO 9001), and company policies.   • Proven ability to influence and engage stakeholders at all levels.
  • Proficient in accident investigation techniques and risk assessment methodologies.
  • Certifications in ISO standards, NEBOSH, OSHA, or equivalent are highly desirable.

description:

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

The Department of Radiology in the College of Medicine at Howard University invites applications for a full-time, tenure-track assistant or associate position with research expertise and teaching interests in advancing mathematics-enhanced artificial intelligence (AI) for radiology and imaging sciences. With an anticipated start date of August 2026, this position is part of the Office of the Provost Artificial Intelligence (AI) Cluster Hire Initiative, which aims to expand AI interdisciplinary research and instruction across the university. This cluster hiring aims to recruit scholars with expertise in the interdisciplinary fields of biomedical imaging, artificial intelligence, and data science. While the Department of Radiology welcomes applicants whose work intersects biology, medicine, or other data-intensive fields, applicants should be scholars who are broadly interested in research that addresses significant scientific or societal challenges through advanced biomedical approaches.

Supervisory Authority

The candidate will supervise postdocs, students, research assistants or lab interns conducting projects.

Nature And Scope

This position is part of the cluster, "Advancing Health through Mathematics Enhanced AI for Radiology and Endocrinology," which is jointly led by the College of Arts and Sciences and the College of Medicine. The goal is to bring together and invest in faculty across departments whose research and scholarship are linked through this cluster and to attract faculty members who can bring different perspectives.

The successful applicant is expected to contribute to an interdisciplinary academic environment through research, teaching, mentorship, and collaboration. Primary responsibilities include leading independent and collaborative research initiatives, applying AI and advanced imaging techniques to biomedical challenges, and participating in student training and curriculum development. The position emphasizes research that addresses health disparities and fosters inclusive excellence.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Leverage Howard University's distinctive resources and datasets to address health disparities impacting historically underserved communities, with an emphasis on leveraging Artificial Intelligence technologies to improve diagnostic, treatment, and prevention strategies for diseases disproportionately affecting these populations.
  • Conduct research across various imaging science fields using disease animal models, including brain injury, neurological diseases, developmental disorders, diabetes, and nanomedicine. Utilize MRI/MRS, PET/CT, and other imaging modalities, incorporating Artificial Intelligence techniques to advance both preclinical and clinical applications.
  • Coordinate research collaborations between the imaging facilities in the Molecular Imaging Laboratory at Howard University. Provide expertise in imaging methods and experimental design from small animal imaging to translational-clinical imaging studies.
  • Organize training sessions and workshops for researchers interested in using the MRI.
  • Participates in academic, didactic, and professional training provided through seminars, workshops and direct meetings with grant faculty.
  • Conducts data collection, statistical analysis, and data interpretation responsibilities related to the Molecular Imaging Laboratory grant portfolio.

Core Competencies

  • Expertise in advanced biomedical imaging modalities (MRI, PET, CT, microscopy) and experience integrating AI techniques into imaging workflows (preferred).
  • Proficiency in programming and operating systems such as Bruker MRI and microPET/CT systems (preferred).
  • Demonstrated experience with machine learning and deep learning frameworks.
  • Strong foundation in statistical analysis, data visualization, and computational modeling.
  • Proven ability to work collaboratively in interdisciplinary research environments.
  • Effective communication and organizational skills; strong written and oral proficiency in English.

Minimum Requirements

  • PhD in Radiological Sciences, Physical Sciences, Chemistry, Biomedical Engineering, Computer Science, or a closely related field.
  • Demonstrated experience in biomedical imaging and AI applications.
  • A strong track record of research productivity and independent funding, or the potential to secure external grants.
  • Enthusiasm for interdisciplinary collaboration and translational research.
  • Teaching or mentoring experience at the undergraduate, graduate, or postdoctoral level is preferred.

Compensation Range: $135,000 -$150,000

description:
Job Description

The Rotational Engineer is an entry-level engineering position for newly graduated engineers. Rotating through each of the core business sectors of ABS, the rotational engineer will spend up to four months each working in engineering, survey, and technology. Through broader and more technically challenging work assignments, the incumbent will develop a thorough understanding of policies, methods, and procedures. Following the completion of each rotation, the engineer will be placed in a permanent role as either Engineer I or Surveyor I.

What You Will Do (under the supervision of an experienced Engineer during the engineering rotation):

  • Performs detailed engineering review of plans as assigned for compliance with applicable Rules, Regulations, and contract commitments.
  • Performs work that involves conventional engineering practices but may include moderately complex problems such as the resolution of conflicting design requirements, material standards, or coordination of activities among other disciplines.
  • With the assistance and guidance of an experienced Surveyor during the survey rotation: Visits vessels, marine structures, and manufacturers for routine survey activities.
  • Performs work that involves conventional surveying practices but may include moderately complex problem resolution and coordination of activities among other disciplines.
  • Conduct research in support of ship and offshore-related classification and rule development.

What You Will Need:

Education and Experience

  • BS degree in a related engineering field, including civil, structural, ocean, marine, mechanical, electrical, or naval architecture.

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

  • Demonstrated computer literacy in engineering software.
  • The ability to identify, analyze and propose solutions to problems.
  • Good command of the English language.
  • Ability to communicate orally and in writing.
  • Ability to work well with others.
  • Obtain knowledge of the ABS Health, Safety, Quality, and Environmental Management System.

Reporting Relationships

The incumbent reports to the Director, Talent Management. This position does not have any direct reports.

About Us

We set out more than 160 years ago to promote the security of life and property at sea and preserve the natural environment. Today, we remain true to our mission and continue to support organizations facing a rapidly evolving seascape of challenging regulations and new technologies. Through it all, we are anchored by a vision and mission that help our clients find clarity in uncertain times.

ABS is a global leader in marine and offshore classification and other innovative safety, quality, and environmental services. We’re at the forefront of supporting the global energy transition at sea, the application of remote and autonomous marine systems, cutting‑edge technical solutions, and many more exciting advancements. Our commitment to safety, reliability, and efficiency is ever‑present, guiding our clients to safer and more efficient operations.

    • Firewall (FW)
    • Web Application Firewall (WAF)
    • Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR)
    • Data Loss Prevention (DLP)
  • Trabalhar de forma integrada com os times de infraestrutura, redes e cloud.

  • Experiência prévia em Segurança da Informação, preferencialmente em Blue Team ou operações de segurança.

  • Vivência em resposta a incidentes de segurança.
  • Conhecimento prático em:
    • Firewall e WAF
    • Soluções de proteção de endpoint (EDR)
    • DLP
    • Redes (TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS)
  • Boa comunicação, perfil colaborativo e capacidade de trabalhar em equipe.

Requisitos desejáveis (não eliminatórios)

  • Experiência em ambientes multinacionais.
  • Conhecimento em frameworks e boas práticas de segurança, como NIST CSF e ISO 27001.
  • Experiência com Cloud Security (AWS, Azure ou GCP).
  • Familiaridade com processos de GRC (Governança, Riscos e Compliance).
  • Certificações relevantes, como CompTIA Security+, Splunk Fundamentals/Power User e ISO 27001 Foundation.

O Inspired é o maior grupo internacional de educação básica premium, com um portfólio de 121 escolas espalhadas pelos 6 continentes e que utilizam as melhores práticas educacionais de cada canto do mundo, garantindo uma experiência de aprendizado de qualidade máxima para mais de 95.000 alunos do Infantil ao Ensino Médio.

Nossas escolas Inspired estão em 27 países e cada uma é pensada individualmente de acordo com o contexto local e é ancorada na cultura vibrante na qual se encontra. Coletivamente, elas compõem uma comunidade que nutre o desenvolvimento acadêmico e pessoal dos alunos num ambiente de aprendizagem progressivo, dinâmico e inovador.

Se juntando ao nosso time de mais de 13.000 colaboradores, você poderá trabalhar em instalações de última geração ao lado de educadores e líderes renomados do setor em alguns dos lugares mais desejados do mundo. Investimos fortemente nas nossas equipes e assim cada um consegue aproveitar desenvolvimento profissional, oportunidades de carreira excepcionais e mobilidade em todo o nosso grupo.

SOBRE A VAGA

A Escola Eleva é uma das escolas Inspired no Brasil. Aqui nós temos vocação para ensinar e paixão por aprender. Nosso time é movido por excelência, entusiasmo, respeito e responsabilidade. Somos adeptos da mentalidade de crescimento e estamos constantemente motivados a buscar o que há de melhor em educação, no Brasil e no mundo e em pensar as melhores maneiras de aplicar isso em nossas escolas e inspirar nossos alunos.

Nossa missão é formar uma nova geração de líderes capazes de fazer a diferença em suas vidas e contribuir para um mundo melhor. Para isso, contamos com um time de profissionais inquietos, com brilho nos olhos e movidos por entusiasmo. Pessoas que superam desafios diariamente, com otimismo e acreditando no legado que estamos construindo.

Nesse papel você será responsável pelo suporte técnico prestado aos usuários, pela manutenção e implantação de equipamentos, programas e sistemas, e pelo planejamento e desempenho da área de TI na unidade. Deve solicitar orçamentos quando necessário, e providenciar a aquisição de equipamentos e licenças.

RESPONSABILIDADES

O que você fará:

  • Gerenciamento de redes, servidores e ativos:
  • Manter os servidores;
  • Realizar a configuração e instalação de novos equipamentos de rede, assegurando que a documentação da rede esteja atualizada;
  • Monitorar redes, verificando logs e equipamentos físicos;
  • Realizar a inclusão, manutenção e exclusão de usuários no ambiente de rede corporativo;
  • Manter e atualizar a lista/inventário de ativos de TDIC da escola.

Suporte técnico:

  • Fornecer apoio técnico aos alunos e colaboradores assegurando o diagnóstico e reparação de problemas técnicos em diversos equipamentos tecnológicos (laptops, projetores, sistemas de informação, servidores etc) de forma que todo o hardware e software funcione corretamente;
  • Preparar equipamentos de TI para utilização;
  • Executar procedimentos de rotina para checar de forma preventiva se equipamentos e soluções estão funcionando como previsto e esperado;
  • Prestar suporte e atendimento a telefonia móvel e VOIP da escola;
  • Manter contatos regulares com as equipes das escolas para verificar preventivamente se as soluções de tecnologia estão funcionando como esperado.

Por mais que nos esforcemos para incluir todas as principais responsabilidades e atribuições desta posição, pode ser que nem toda atividade pertinente à função tenha sido identificada. Dessa forma, a lista acima não é restritiva e pode ser estendida ou alterada para incluir outras tarefas que se aplicam ao cargo.

REQUISITOS

O que você precisa ter:

  • Ensino superior completo na área de TI - Ciências da Computação, Análise de Sistemas, Rede de Computadores ou afins;
  • Experiência com suporte técnico de TI, sistemas operacionais clientes Windows (Windows server 2012 ou superior), Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, WSUS, File server, Print Server, ativos de rede (impressoras, scanners, WIFI);
  • Conhecimento básico para gerenciar regras de firewall;
  • Habilidades de instalação e configuração de hardware e software;
  • Inglês intermediário.

Será um diferencial se você tiver:

  • Experiência em escolas ou projetos pedagógicos;
  • Conhecimento em arquitetura Meraki, Fortigate, Ubiquiti ou Mikrotik;
  • Certificação ITIL ou similar em redes de computadores ou projetos;
  • Conhecimento de métodos ágeis;
  • Inglês avançado.

DECLARAÇÃO DE SALVAGUARDA

O Inspired se compromete em salvaguardar e promover o bem-estar das crianças e jovens e, se você se juntar ao nosso time, esperaremos o mesmo de você, assim como que se comprometa a realizar os treinamentos de safeguarding que consideramos pertinentes à sua função. A proteção do bem-estar dos nossos alunos é de responsabilidade de todos os colaboradores e os mesmos devem se comportar de maneira a refletir os princípios e valores da organização. Qualquer candidato pode ser submetido aos procedimentos apropriados de verificação.

Visit our careers site for more information;

description:
Overview

Na ANBIMA, seu trabalho tem o poder de impactar pessoas, mercado e sociedade.

Somos uma estrutura de inteligência do mercado financeiro e de capitais. Representamos bancos, corretoras, gestoras de recursos, securitizadoras e outras empresas, para tomar juntos as melhores decisões que vão guiar o futuro do mercado.

Nossa missão é fazer com que os negócios cresçam e desenvolvam em todo o seu potencial, transformando a economia do nosso país.

Buscamos um Analista de Projetos que será responsável por conectar as necessidades das áreas de negócios, as entregas dos times, terá uma atuação direta na gestão e evolução dos projetos, garantindo que as demandas sejam corretamente priorizadas e acompanhadas nas ferramentas utilizadas pelo time.

Responsibilities and Assignments

  • Assegurar aderência às políticas internas, padrões de governança e compliance;

  • Atuar como facilitador entre as equipes técnicas e as áreas de negócio, assegurando comunicação eficiente e tomada de decisão baseada em dados;
  • Responsável por elaborar relatórios executivos, indicadores de performance (KPIs) e apresentações para comitês e gestores;
  • Participar da elaboração e acompanhamento do Plano Diretor, contribuindo para o planejamento estratégico das iniciativas da área em alinhamento com as diretrizes corporativas e priorização de projetos e demandas conforme objetivos de negócio e restrição de recursos.

  • Capacidade de analisar requisitos, definir cronogramas, mapear riscos e propor planos de mitigação;
  • Visão estratégica, capacidade analítica, comunicação clara e visão orientada a resultados;
  • Formação superior completa em Administração, Engenharia, Economia, TI ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência em metodologias de gestão de projetos (PMBOK, Scrum, Kanban) e ferramentas (MS Project, Jira);

  • Certificações como PMP, PSM - Scrum Master, PSPO – Product Owner ou similares;
  • Certificação ITIL Foundation;

  • Ter experiência mínima comprovada superior a 5 anos em empresa de médio ou grande porte, com atuação em gestão de projetos;
  • Experiência com metodologias ágeis e tradicionais;
  • Ter experiência mínima comprovada superior a 5 anos em empresa de médio ou grande porte, com atuação em gestão de projetos.

Softkills Necessários

  • Lidar bem com trabalhos em equipe;
  • Senso analítico apurado;
  • Boa capacidade de comunicação oral e escrita;
  • Nível técnico de leitura e comunicação escrita em inglês;
  • Boa capacidade de documentação;
  • Capacidade de autoaprendizagem;
  • Capacidade de trabalhar sob pressão e cumprir prazos;
  • Bom relacionamento interpessoal;
  • Dinamismo;
  • Capacidade de negociação;
  • Habilidade para documentar processos e procedimentos.

Benefits

  • Vale Refeição R$ 1.177,00;
  • Vale Alimentação R$ 925,00;
  • Assistência Médica;
  • Assistência Odontológica;
  • Modelo de trabalho híbrido;

  • Previdência Privada;
  • Auxílio Home Office;
  • Licença Parental de 6 meses para todos os colaboradores da ANBIMA;
  • Auxílio Funeral;
  • Parcerias, Day Off de aniversário e muito mais...

Location

Nosso escritório fica na região do centro do Rio de Janeiro. Estamos trabalhando de forma híbrida, escritório (3x por semana) e home-office (2x por semana).

About

Muito prazer, somos a ANBIMA – Associação Brasileira das Entidades dos Mercados Financeiro e de Capitais. Falamos em nome de instituições como bancos, gestoras, corretoras, distribuidoras e administradoras. Temos a missão de fortalecer a representação do setor e apoiar a evolução de um mercado de capitais capaz de financiar o desenvolvimento econômico e social do Brasil e influenciar o mercado global.

Somos protagonistas da evolução da indústria de investimentos, trazendo impacto e legado positivos ao nosso país. Se você tem sede de aprender a impactar o desenvolvimento econômico e social do Brasil, a ANBIMA é para você!

description:
Imagine your career taking you to the depths of innovation and the heights of impact. Our people enable continuous progress. Their commitment, collective expertise, and unique capabilities are the engine room behind SBM Offshore’s True. Blue. Transition. - shaping the future of energy, and beyond.

About Us

SBM Offshore is the world’s deepwater ocean-infrastructure expert. Our work is already resulting in cleaner, more efficient energy production. True. Blue. Transition. is our promise to enable that into the future while at the same time using our expertise to support new and existing markets in the blue economy. It starts with Advancing our Core: continuing to advance the decarbonization of traditional energy production. While Pioneering More: helping to enable the energy transition and using our unique capabilities in ocean infrastructure to support more industries to grow sustainably. Sharing our experience for a better blue tomorrow.

Purpose

  • As Buyer, you are responsible for procuring materials, equipment, and services required for project or operations execution. This role involves negotiating contracts and commercial terms, and ensuring timely delivery to support project and operations timelines and budgets.

Responsibilities

  • Procurement Planning: You develop and implement procurement plans based on project requirements, timelines, and budgets.
  • Supplier Sourcing: You follow strategic sourcing category manager framing and evaluate suppliers, ensuring they meet quality, cost, and delivery requirements.
  • Contract Negotiation: You negotiate terms and conditions with suppliers to secure favorable agreements while mitigating risks. You align with the Category Management team as needed.
  • Purchase Orders: You issue and manage purchase orders, ensuring accuracy and compliance with project specifications and company policies.
  • Cost Control: You ensure procurement activities align with budget constraints and identify cost‑saving opportunities without compromising quality.
  • Compliance: You ensure all procurement activities comply with industry regulations, company policies, and safety standards.
  • Reporting: You provide regular updates to project managers and stakeholders on procurement status, potential risks, and mitigation strategies.

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in supply chain management, engineering, business administration, or a related field

Experience

  • Proven experience in procurement within the oil and gas industry.
  • Strong negotiation and communication skills.
  • Proficiency in procurement software and Microsoft Office Suite.
  • Excellent organizational and analytical abilities.
  • Knowledge of industry regulations and compliance requirements.
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast‑paced, deadline‑driven environment.

Functional Competencies

  • Commercial

  • Regulatory Management
  • Project Procurement Strategy and Management
  • SBM Product Knowledge
  • Purchasing Tools and Processes
  • Strategic Sourcing and Vendor Management
  • Contract Management

  • Product Costing

title: Voice and Services Engineer - São Paulo / Rio de Janeiro
description:
1GLOBAL is a technology-driven global mobile communications provider, delivering global connectivity solutions to enterprises and consumers. Powered by a best-in-class telecom platform - including its own owned and operated global mobile core network, fully fledged in-house developed eSIM technology, and an extensive portfolio of telecom licenses - 1GLOBAL operates as a fully regulated telecommunications provider across 40 countries worldwide.

We serve many of the world's leading banks, enterprises, and digital-first businesses, including neo-banks, global fast moving consumer goods companies, travel leaders, and payment service providers. Today, 1GLOBAL connects more than 70 million people and devices globally , enabling our customers to launch, scale, and innovate with confidence in the mobile ecosystem.

1GLOBAL is a profitable, fast-growing business. With full-year revenues in 2025 exceeding US$200 million and profits of over US$25 million , we generate strong cash flows to fund our growth allowing us to continuously invest in infrastructure, platform innovation, and global expansion. Recent years have marked a defining phase in our journey, with major enterprise and mass-consumer client wins accelerating our evolution into a global mobile connectivity powerhouse, purpose-built to enable consumer brands to enter and succeed with their own aspirations to offer telecommunications services to their clients.

Founded in 2022 by experienced technology entrepreneurs, Hakan Koçand Pyrros Koussios, 1GLOBAL has rapidly emerged as a European technology leader shaping the future of global telecommunications . We operate as a fully regulated Mobile Virtual Network Operator (MVNO) in 12 countries and as a regulated telecom operator in an additional 28 markets. Headquartered in the Netherlands, with world-class R&D hubs in Lisbon, Berlin, and São Paulo, our team of close to 500 experts across 15 countries is united by a single ambition: to redefine global mobile connectivity through technology, scale, and execution excellence.

About the Team

As a Network Engineering member, in the Voice and Services functional area, you will be responsible to propose, analyze and define the requirements for new and existing services and systems, related with the voice systems under the responsibility of the functional area. Prepare, design, test and provide new solutions or product changes of the already existing portfolio. Define and support the technology evolution roadmap for the systems under the functional area. Participate and support the other functional areas in cross functional projects.

About the Role

  • Collaboration with other Networks teams in defining and managing the projects for delivery of new solutions
  • Project delivery. Network design. Integration and migration strategy definition. Collaboration with other relevant departments. Responsible for end-to-end delivery
  • Design of new consumer and corporate telecom solutions
  • Creation of technical documentation (HLD's, LLD's, WO's, etc.) and maintain it over the lifecycle of the solutions
  • Perform implementations in live environment. Understanding of End to End system testing requirements
  • Follow-up and define Quality and Performance indicators
  • Capacity and Performance Analysis, Reporting and Improvement Solution Definition
  • Service & Resource configuration definition and implementation on requested systems
  • Work on complex solutions that influence the design of current products and addresses design issues for future products or technologies
  • Close relationship with external partners like carriers, service providers
  • Elaborate, and manage the process, for change requests to current partners in order to meet the network necessities
  • Control the network elements roadmap, being responsible for the necessary software/hardware upgrade during the components lifecycle
  • Generate and implement process improvements, including and especially cross-team processes
  • Documents the existing technology portfolio and proposes recommendations for improvements and/or alternatives

Requirements

About You

Must-haves

  • Proven experience on implementation of live solutions on mobile telecom (GSM, UMTS, LTE, IMS), networks design, capacity management, engineering and architecture
  • Knowledge of 3GPP, GSMA, ITU standards and specifications
  • Experience in the design, test and operation of NGN based networks, including MSS/MGW, HLR/HSS, SBC
  • Experience in defining, establishing and maintaining voice interconnects, SIP/RTP based
  • Understanding about IMS architecture. Knowledge about VoIP, VoLTE, VoWiFi, and QoS
  • Experience with SMS service configuration and routing
  • IMS Architecture with understanding of IMS nodes including P/S/I-CSCF, Application Servers
  • IMS Protocol Interfaces - GM Interface, ISC interface, Sh Interface, Cx, SOAP/XML, etc
  • Experience in mobile services charging (offline, online). Knowledge and experience of OCS and, Ro, Ro+, Ga and Bp interfaces
  • Knowledge and experience with Diameter/SCTP networks and protocol
  • Knowledge and experience with Signaling Gateways and protocols including SS7, SIGTRAN, MAP and CAMEL
  • Experience with protocol analyzer tools like Wireshark, Astelia, and ability to use them to troubleshoot networks errors/problems for the mentioned protocols
  • Experience with ETSI NFV architecture and solutions
  • Familiar with MVNO/MVNE/MVNA architecture(s) and landscape
  • English proficiency mandatory, other languages are a plus
  • Degree in Telecom Engineering or Computer Science or equivalent experience

Nice-to-haves

  • +3 years working on telecoms, designing and implementing mobile core networks

Job Overview

We are seeking a Human Factors Engineer to join the Loss Prevention Organization (LP).

LP is responsible for providing both day-to-day in-field occupational and process safety support to Saudi Aramco operations, as well as centralized technical support and consulting function. Our field offices are located in Abqaiq, Riyadh, Ras Tanura, Dhahran, Udhailiyah, Jeddah (including Yanbu and Jazan), and Tanajib. Through these offices, LP provides its services to all Saudi Aramco facilities and departments that are located throughout the Kingdom.

Your primary role is to embed principles of human and organizational factors in operational process and capital projects, promote a sound safety culture, build human factors capability in the company and share human factors knowledge as well as engage with the industry.

Key Responsibilities

As the successful candidate you will be required to perform the following:

  • Develop corporate policies, guidelines, standards and specifications for human factors.
  • Develop tools to incorporate human factors in qualitative and quantitative risk assessments (e.g., human failure analysis, safety critical task analysis, human reliability analysis) as well as support risk assessment activities that involve these tools.
  • Introduce human performance tools to error-proof routine and non-routine field activities, including embedding human factors thinking into the day-to-day activities (e.g., site inspections, work permitting, pre and post job briefings, JSA).
  • Participate, review and analyze human factors issues in incident investigations.
  • Advise on Human Factors Engineering (HFE) integration in capital projects, verifying compliance with international and company HFE standards as well as Human-Machine Interface (HMI) specifications.
  • Streamline critical communications for frontline workers, advising on shift turnover practices, communication interfaces between work group and between organizations.
  • Advise facilities on how to manage fatigue risk and best practices in shift work schedule design, including safe manning levels, optimal workload and allocation of functions.
  • Develop programs and strategies for driving and sustaining a positive safety culture, operationalizing proven methods to assess safety culture, and driving targeted interventions.
  • Develop methods to measure psychological safety and action plans to address areas for improvement.
  • Identify and lead the deployment of innovative technologies to reduce human failure.
  • Provide awareness as well as technical training for different human factors topics.
  • Mentor other LP personnel.
  • You will hold a Bachelor degree in Engineering, industrial psychology, human factors, ergonomics, or safety from an Accredited Institution.
  • You will have 7 years of experience as a human factor professional in the oil and gas, petrochemicals, or related industries, including as strong track record in delivering results.
  • You will hold a recognized certification in human factors such as Certified Human Factors Professional (CHFP), Certified Professional Ergonomist (CPE), Chartered Ergonomics and Human Factors Specialist (C.ErgHF), or European Ergonomist (Eur.Erg).
  • You will have an excellent ability to communicate in English with peers as well as members of management, and be able to produce clear and concise oral and written reports in English.

Our patented technology collects and analyzes data from connected sensors like cameras, radar, and traffic signal controllers to help predict and prevent road incidents. Role Overview

We are looking for a Deployment & Maintenance Software Engineer to support the setup, deployment, and ongoing reliability of our software and hardware across client projects. In this role, you will manage server configurations, oversee deployments, monitor live systems, and help keep performance and uptime high.   • Identify process gaps and implement practical improvements to speed up deployments and reduce incidents

  • Solid understanding of networking fundamentals, including:
  • SSH and secure connections (ports, authentication methods)
  • Public vs private IP addresses
  • TCP vs UDP
  • Routing concepts (static vs dynamic)
  • NAT, port forwarding, and port mapping

  • Certifications such as Certified Fire Protection Specialist (CFPS) or a Professional Engineer (PE) license in Fire Protection are preferred. Proficiency and deep understanding of NFPA/EN standards and hazardous material handling are essential.

We are hiring engineering leaders to work across the breadth of our Ubuntu Engineering organisation - leaders who care deeply for quality, performance and resilience in software, and have a proven track record for building, nurturing and developing high performing engineering teams.

This leadership track includes roles for managers and Senior+ engineers alike. At Canonical, managers are expected to stay technical and close to the code, and our Senior+ engineers lead and develop software projects, as well as the processes and people around them.

Our teams integrate the freshest open source software, provide robust upgrade paths and engineer the future of Ubuntu. Ubuntu is not just the world's most deployed open source operating system, it's a platform that enables innovation for millions of users across the globe. Our community represents the full breadth of the developer experience; from students, hobbyists and freelancers to high performance engineering and creative teams in corporate and academic environments.

Four key teams that ship Ubuntu are the

  • Foundations : maintaining foundational software: architectures, package managers, compilers, toolchains, bootloaders, filesystems and core utilities
  • Server : leading the design, evolution and future of our Ubuntu Server distribution
  • Desktop : driving Ubuntu Desktop, our future immutable desktop: Ubuntu Core Desktop, WSL, gaming technology, and a suite of modern applications for the desktop crafted with Flutter

Technical leadership experience and a background in software engineering are necessary prerequisites for this role.   • Professional written and spoken English
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
  • Result‑oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel twice a year, for company events up to two weeks each

Nice‑to‑have skills
